journalEntries.name: Advancements in the Archipelago
journalEntries.reason:
In the far-away archipelago of the …, an increase in international trade has set the stage for a burgeoning middle class to gain more influence despite ongoing political upheavals.

Grow the domestic agricultural sector, increase the Standard of Living, and build ports to secure a fruitful future for the ….

journalEntries.name: Atocha Railway Station
journalEntries.reason:
For many years, the … have sought to construct Atocha Railway Station in …. Their efforts have been thwarted by conflicting demands and interests—from government intervention to the death of the hired architect meant to oversee construction. No proposal has met all criteria until now.

The hopes of … to build the station have not waned. They believe Atocha Railway Station will be a key institution for … not only within …, but throughout all of the continent as well.

journalEntries.name: Construct a Skyscraper
journalEntries.reason: Having identified the optimal site for our skyscraper, we must set about the monumental task of its construction. When it is completed we expect this structure to be among the tallest in all the world.

journalEntries.name: Construct the Panama Canal
journalEntries.reason: We have determined that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. We must now secure the region and construct the canal.

journalEntries.name: Construct the Suez Canal
journalEntries.reason: We have determined that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Mediterranean to the Red Sea. We must now secure the region and construct the canal.

journalEntries.name: Glorious Eden
journalEntries.reason: The spouse of … … has recently aquired the old Pena Convent atop the Sintra Mountains. With great artistic ambition, he seeks to transform the monastery into a summer residence for the royal family.

journalEntries.name: Gran Teatro
journalEntries.reason:
In the heart of … is the Plaza de Isabella, a finely kept square where one can find some of the most fashionable cafés and restaurants of …. People of all classes gather from nine o'clock in the evening until the small hours of the morning, bringing the plaza to life. Teatro Tacón is among the many fine establishments opposite of the sqaure. But despite the magnificent interior,  its exterior appearance leaves much to be desired.

… members of the … have drafted a proposal to expand and transform the site where Teatro Tacón sits into the Grand Theater of Havana with the hopes that it will be much celebrated in the decades to come.

journalEntries.name: Innere Stadt
journalEntries.reason:
In the heart of … is the Ringstrasse—a grand boulevard that encircles the city centre. A panel of … jurors have reviewed countless proposals that transform this pocket of … with an imperial forum, new seats of government, and exemplary cultural institutions. Now that the old city walls are demolished, this initiative ushers … into a new era of urbanity.

Kaiserforum will need to be built in several phases and may be constructed in the State Panel for ….

journalEntries.name: Patronize Realist Art
journalEntries.reason: Artists are moving away from abstract, fantastical art and towards realistic portrayals of a concrete subject matter. As patrons of this movement there could be much to gain.

journalEntries.name: Patronize Romanticism
journalEntries.reason: The Romantic artistic movement advocates for the glorious past: knights, castles, pirates, forbidden nature and lost heroes. Its appealing nature must be swiftly spread.

journalEntries.name: Urbanize …
journalEntries.reason: The future is not white or black, like the old tales say—it's gray! The color of the train that lets us visit foreign lands! The color of the factory that lets us pay for such a travel! The color, my friend, of progress.

journalEntries.name: War Wounded
journalEntries.reason: Disease is running rampant amongst the war wounded in the … war. The facilities to deal with the wounded are overwhelmed. We need to reduce the levels of disease somehow or more will die.

journalEntries.goal: The … dynasty maintains uninterrupted rule at no less than … Legitimacy. The higher Legitimacy the dynasty can achieve the sooner they will secure the throne.
journalEntries.name: Cement the House of …
journalEntries.reason: France is a tumultuous land, and has seen more governments come and go in recent generations than some other countries have seen pass over centuries. To firmly establish the monarchy, the House of … must prove that it can provide the stability France cries out for.

journalEntries.name: Divided Monarchists
journalEntries.reason: Three dynastic lines have claims on the French throne: the Orléanists, who back the constitutional July Monarchy established in 1830, the Legitimists who support the deposed Charles X of Bourbon and his descendants, and the Bonapartists, who seek to restore Napoleon Bonaparte's family to power. All three dynastic monarchists vie with the powers-that-be and each other to see their particular claimants put upon the throne of France.

journalEntries.name: A New National Identity
journalEntries.reason: Although once part of a greater continuum, sharing a common colonial government and common leadership with our neighbors, we have diverged considerably since we won our independence. It is time we fully assumed a new … identity.

journalEntries.name: Build Local Arms Industry
journalEntries.reason: At the request of the Armed Forces, we have promised to reduce our dependence on foreign arms imports by funding our own industrial production of weaponry.

journalEntries.name: Call for Women’s Suffrage
journalEntries.reason: The rise of the Suffragist movement, calling for the voting franchise to be extended to eligible female citizens, has become a prominent feature of the contemporary political landscape.

journalEntries.name: Commitment: Economic Initiative
journalEntries.reason: We have vowed to steer the … investment towards …. The … eagerly await the results of the initiative, which they insist will only lead to the betterment of life for all … citizens.

journalEntries.name: Commitment: Enlarge the Army
journalEntries.reason:
We have sworn commitments with the … to increase the might of our nation's military. 

Either by training more troops, or by upgrading their equipment, we will ensure … stands ready to defend its interests.

journalEntries.name: Commitment: Promised Enactment
journalEntries.reason:
After supporting the …'s efforts to pass …, the … are expecting the Government to honor its obligations and pass ….

Should we fail to enact … in time, the … will be greatly displeased, faith in the …'s government will be shattered, and there will be a greater risk of a Revolution or Coup.

journalEntries.name: Commitment: Tax Cuts
journalEntries.reason: We have made a deal with the … to lower taxes so the economy can flourish. Now we must retain taxes at the current level, no matter the state finances, or else risk angering the … and the populace at large.

journalEntries.name: Commitment: The Common People
journalEntries.reason: We have sworn an oath to the … to improve the lives of the common people. There is truly no more noble goal for the rulers of this nation than increasing the Standard of Living of our … citizens.

journalEntries.name: Commitment: Valued Investments
journalEntries.reason: We have promised the … to construct more … within our States, an action that will surely improve the … economy.

journalEntries.name: Corn Laws
journalEntries.reason: Our prohibitive import tax on grains acts as a strong protectionist policy for the interests of the landowning class and will cause an upheaval if removed.

journalEntries.name: Freedom of Thought
journalEntries.reason: By allowing the word to be free, the thought will be freed with it, ushering in a new era of radical innovation and reform.

journalEntries.goal: Increase … Trade by 50%.
journalEntries.name: Freedom of Trade
journalEntries.reason: An open country which trades with neighbors and distant nations alike is key to a future of economic liberalism.

journalEntries.name: Government Petition
journalEntries.reason:
As a loyal component of the …'s government, the … are petitioning for … to pass.

If … is successfully passed, the … will be greatly pleased, but if this petition is ignored, the nation will face penalties, up to the …'s resignation from government.

journalEntries.goal: Has reclaimed at least 20 Arable Land
journalEntries.name: Land Reclamation
journalEntries.reason: The Netherlands is densely populated, and arable land is increasingly scarce. Through great works of engineering, we can reclaim new land from the sea.

journalEntries.name: Mutual Aid
journalEntries.reason: If there is a State, there must be domination of one class by another and, as a result, slavery; the State without slavery is unthinkable – and this is why we are the enemies of the State.

journalEntries.name: Nation Above Self
journalEntries.reason: A safe country must be safe from within. Traitors and plotters can be everywhere, and we must be able to take care of them.

journalEntries.name: National Awakening
journalEntries.reason:
Whilst … has taken its first steps towards nationhood, it remains a land of peasants. Much of our populace continues to view the world through the lens of village and clan, rather than that of national brotherhood. We must foster cultural Fervor amongst our populace, and construct a unified nation from the … people.

The Fervor of the … culture is affected by the following conditions:
• Average Literacy of … Pops
• Quantity of … …
• … countries researching Nationalism and Pan-nationalism
• Average Acceptance of … pops
• Independent or formerly-independent … countries

journalEntries.goal: The following conditions must be true for a total of 5 years (can be interrupted):
journalEntries.name: Opium Crisis
journalEntries.reason: Vast numbers of our people have become opium fiends. This is a national disgrace that must be addressed urgently.

journalEntries.name: Our Nation, Our Culture
journalEntries.reason: The homeland of our ancestors belongs to us, and to us it shall return.

journalEntries.name: Our Revolution
journalEntries.reason: Communism cannot be achieved until the needs of all have been fulfilled. From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.

journalEntries.name: Paranoid Slave Owners
journalEntries.reason: A low, but noticeable level of turmoil among slaves in some states has caused slaveholders to grow increasingly concerned about the …. They have begun a harsh crackdown against the slightest signs of rebellion amongst the enslaved populace.

journalEntries.name: Path to Liberalism
journalEntries.reason: A more democratic society with the right ideals will lay the groundwork for a country where the liberty of all citizens is paramount.

journalEntries.goal: Improve GDP by 50%
journalEntries.name: Reform the Indies
journalEntries.reason: It has become clear to the Company that exploiting the East Indies through the antiquated continuation of agrarian feudalism and slavery is not a viable strategy. We must transform the economy thoroughly, so that exploitation can be achieved through private enterprise and investment instead.

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for 30 total years:
journalEntries.name: Religion, Autocracy, Nationality
journalEntries.reason: Our nation is defined by the absolute authority of our beloved ruler. We are one family, with one father and one fatherland; united and strong. If we wish to preserve these values, the Autocracy must be maintained.

journalEntries.name: Restore Order
journalEntries.reason: Desperate times call for desperate measures. With the radicals at the gates threatening to destroy traditional hierarchies, we must be prepared to use coercion to restore order.

journalEntries.name: Securing the Power
journalEntries.reason: The … has become too powerful for their own good, given the opinion they hold of us, and are threatening our peaceful government.

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for 5 total years:
journalEntries.name: Stamp Out Monarchism
journalEntries.reason: It is time to put the outdated system of hereditary rule behind us. The monarchy must be removed and its supporters humbled, and it must be given time to fade into memory.

journalEntries.goal: The progress of the emerging … National Identity has reached 100%
journalEntries.name: The … Nation
journalEntries.reason:
The independence of … from Spain has given rise to rumblings of nationalism across the nation. As our nation advances into the future, our intellectuals seek to formulate a new identity, one that is distinctly and solely ….

The following conditions will benefit the process of developing our national identity:
• … or … Interest Groups that are In Government or have high Clout
• Ongoing Wars with high War Support
• …, …, and … buildings with high Occupancy
• High national Prestige
• Not owning non-… Homelands

The progress of this national awakening is expected to progress by #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_south_american_national_identity_emergence_special_tooltip … next month.

Completing this Journal Entry will exclude … from pursuing greater pan-national ambitions

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for 10 total years:
journalEntries.name: The …-in-Parliament
journalEntries.reason: The end of absolutist rule in … has not settled the question of the balance of powers between the … and …. In order to cement itself, the new parliamentary order must establish the will of the people to be above the will of the ….

journalEntries.name: The Age of Caudillos
journalEntries.reason:
The status of the Progress Bar will be determined by various #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_caudillo_special_tooltip_advance positive or #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_caudillo_special_tooltip_deplete negative conditions. The Progress Bar reaching 100 will cement the power of military strongmen in ….

Depleting the progress bar and keeping the … out of government will destroy Caudillismo in the … and end the threat of military strongmen in the country.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, our nation will have an elevated chance of a Coup, and any Voting law enacted will gain the Electoral Clientelism Amendment.

Following our independence from Spain, a power vacuum was left in the place of the dismantled colonial governments, which was quickly filled by charismatic military leaders. These "caudillos" have come to define much of South American politics.

journalEntries.name: The Ethical Policy
journalEntries.reason: Previous colonial administrations have allowed the people under their rule to wallow in poverty and ignorance, laboring under a government interested only in what it can extract from them. We have a chance to do better; to provide for these huddled masses a basic education as well as sufficient means to feed and clothe themselves.

journalEntries.goal: Achieve … Gross Domestic Product
journalEntries.name: The Five-Year Plans
journalEntries.reason: Communism is worker's power plus the electrification of the whole country.

journalEntries.name: The Metropolitan Police
journalEntries.reason: As cities grow and dangerous ideas spread, the need to maintain public order becomes even more essential. The police must have the manpower and resources that they need to keep the peace, with priority given to the heart of our nation.

journalEntries.name: The Modernization Program
journalEntries.reason: A powerful country is powerful from the very pillars that sustain it. We must expand our infrastructure in order to expand our wealth.

journalEntries.name: The New Colossus
journalEntries.reason: People of all races and creeds will be welcome in our free and open society!

journalEntries.name: The New Machine
journalEntries.reason:
The establishment of a … in … has represented a tremendous step towards the realization of a competent, orderly, and wealthy society. However, the mere presence of the … and … does not suffice to erase the mistakes and inefficiencies of the old order. Much work yet remains to realize our transformation of society, and the masses remain skeptical of our project.

To cement the new regime, we must complete our agenda, and demonstrate that Technocracy will realize the era of peace and plenty that they desire.

journalEntries.goal:
One of the following:
… has enacted … or …, and all Nihilist interest groups are suppressed for more than 5 years
… has maintained the positive support of the …, or has kept them marginalized for more than 5 years
journalEntries.name: The Nihilist Movement
journalEntries.reason: Claiming to desire the abolition of all things declared to be sacred, a movement of radical … has begun to spread tracts condemning divinely-appointed rule. This movement threatens the very foundations of our government with its criticism.

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for at least 5 years:
journalEntries.name: The People's Revolution
journalEntries.reason: The people still suffer under the tyrant heel of kings, priests, and capitalists. We must overthrow the reactionary government and establish a worker's paradise.

journalEntries.name: The Positive Stage
journalEntries.reason:
Followers of the social theory of Positivism have begun organizing for political reform in …. The Positivists desire to focus on the future of …, and for the nation to develop and industrialize under the governance of technical experts.

Effects at the conclusion of this Journal Entry will depend on the degree of influence that the Positivists secure

Positivism is the philosophical theory that all things may be derived by logic and reason from the senses. The Positivist movement advocates for reforms based on the scientific principles, to advance beyond the theorized "theological" and "metaphysical" stages of human development and establish a society based on full knowledge of the natural world.

journalEntries.name: The Spectre Haunting the World
journalEntries.reason:
The rising prevalence of socialist unrest within … has begun to coalesce into a movement that threatens the rule of the upper classes. Struggle between classes has acquired a sharper edge as … workers adopt the methods and principles of the socialist movement.

The voices of the proletariat cry out for liberty, for equality, and for bread. Workers of the world, unite!

journalEntries.name: The State and Revolution
journalEntries.reason: The proletariat needs state power, a centralized organization of force, an organization of violence, both to crush the resistance of the exploiters and to lead the enormous mass of the population to the organization of a socialist economy.

journalEntries.goal: The following conditions must be true for a total of 10 years (can be interrupted):
journalEntries.name: The Temperance Movement
journalEntries.reason: Although their stances come from very different premises, both the … and … have agreed that alcohol is a poison to the mind. Only a government ban will end this evil.

journalEntries.name: Vigor and Greatness
journalEntries.reason:
Whether it stems from foreign powers or from malcontents within our borders, the threat of socialism threatens to destroy the … nation. We must all march under the same banner. We cannot forget who our leaders are, and how their strength represents our only defense against this threat.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, the rate at which #tooltippable;tooltip:…,fascist_ideologies_list_tt Fascist characters appear will be increased.

journalEntries.name: Economic Regeneration
journalEntries.reason:
Long gone are the days when … was a byword for wealth. Centuries of mismanagement and misfortune have rendered the … economy a shadow of its former self—unable to meet even the most basic demands of the modern age. 

But as Jesus raised Lazarus from his tomb, so too shall the good men of the Hacienda raise the … economy from its long slumber. For …'s destiny is to be found not in the decrepit empires of yore, but in the strength of tomorrow.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Agriculture
journalEntries.reason:
To traverse the less-developed regions of the Meseta Central is to step back through time. The ploughs and tools of the farmers therein remain little changed from those of their ancestors; their yields stunted by practices long abandoned elsewhere.

Without reform, the land cannot hope to sustain the prosperity of ….

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Colonial
journalEntries.reason:
During the so-called Golden Century, much of …'s wealth came from her colonies. While the dynamics of colonialism has changed much since then, certain truths hold as well today now as they did then:

The Ultramar contains great riches, and we would be fools not to exploit them.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Industry
journalEntries.reason:
In no place is …'s premodernity felt as keenly as in her manufactoring sector. Still largely artisanal in nature, … manufactories have been struggling to compete with cheap, foreign goods, save for in a select few localities like Barcelona.

By developing a strong manufacturing sector in key locations across our realm, we can turn the tide of foreign economic domination.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Land Reform
journalEntries.reason:
The question of land reform has long been on the lips of … politicians, with some seeking to break the power of the great landowning elites of the south, while other seek to cement it even further.

The time has come for the government to decide, and to pursue its course with unwavering resolve.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Mining
journalEntries.reason:
The Iberian peninsula is home to large, untapped deposits of raw minerals, rife for exploitation.

While the sector currently remains underdeveloped, our chief geologists insist that the ground holds enough wealth for us to propel the nation into a new golden era of mining—surpassing even the days of Roman Hispania.

Mortality of Engineers employed in Mines

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Railways
journalEntries.reason:
Of the many great inventions of this age, few measure up to the raw potential of the steam locomotive. The … interior has long remained relatively isolated from the rest of the country, hemmed in by mountainous terrain, poor road networks, and rivers that are only navigable in part.

But, where cart and barge has failed, the steam locomotive shall triumph, and every inch of … soil will be as connected to the wider market as the port of Bilbao is today.

journalEntries.name: Antarctic Expedition
journalEntries.reason: The mysteries of our planet are slowly coming to an end. Being the first to map the South Pole would give us invaluable scientific knowledge.

journalEntries.name: Congo River Expedition
journalEntries.reason: The heart of the African continent remains a mystery for many. We shall launch an expedition to plot the course of the Congo River.

journalEntries.name: Niger River Expedition
journalEntries.reason: An expedition shall be launched to plot the course of the Niger River.

journalEntries.name: Nile River Expedition
journalEntries.reason: The center of the African continent holds the secret to the source of the Nile.

journalEntries.name: Western Frontier Expedition
journalEntries.reason: An expedition to map out the unknown regions and geography of the North American Western Frontier.

journalEntries.name: Afghan Reunification
journalEntries.reason:
The succession crisis sparked by the death of Timur Shah Durrani in 1793 has thrown the former Durrani Empire into a period of endless civil strife. With the threat of European powers enroaching from all sides, we must take it upon ourselves to end this period of warring principalities and reconstruct a unified Afghanistan.

While appealing to a European Great Power to assist us in reunification may earn us their support, their opponents will become more hostile towards our goals.

journalEntries.name: Bolívar's Ambition
journalEntries.reason: The greatest extent of the ambitions of Simón Bolívar was his proposed Federation of the Andes, a great confederation of all Latin America. Despite its initial failure at the Congress of Panama, the winds have changed, and the threat of European and American encroachment has created the environment for a possible revival of the idea.

journalEntries.name: Central American Reunification
journalEntries.reason: The collapse of the United Provinces of Central America into disparate fiefdoms has left the region impoverished and vulnerable to the most avaricious exploitation. If Central America ever wishes to take full advantage of the potential of the modern era, it must stand as one.

journalEntries.name: Crisis and Opportunity
journalEntries.reason: The crisis wracking the Ottoman Empire has granted us an opportunity to secure further influence in the …. By seeing to the creation of a … state, we may both weaken the Ottoman sphere and grant ourselves credibility as protector of … people across Europe.

journalEntries.name: Earning Recognition
journalEntries.reason:
The status of the Progress Bar will #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_earn_recognition_advance advance or #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_earn_recognition_deplete retreat based on certain conditions. The Progress Bar reaching 200 will result in … becoming a Recognized Power.

For too long has … been denied proper diplomatic recognition by the so-called civilized nations of the world, leaving us vulnerable to their advances and without the ability to properly exercise our own sovereign rights.

We should do our utmost to rectify this situation, and claim a seat for ourselves at their table as respected equals.

journalEntries.name: Establish Colonial Administration
journalEntries.reason:
In order to best leverage our rule over our African holdings, a Colonial Administration may be established over a given region of the continent. Colonial Administrations will expand into neighboring Decentralized Nations on their own, and may be given jurisdiction over our other regional holdings.

The Scramble for Africa, so it is called, is underway in earnest. Every power worth a hoot is seeking slices of the great continent as more jewels in their crowns. Rich in untapped resources and filled with people yet to be put to work, power and prestige are the prizes for the victors. Make no mistake: blood will be spilled long before the scramble ends. Africa awaits.

journalEntries.name: Foreign Legal Imposition
journalEntries.reason: Our … … has declared it imperative that we enact ….

journalEntries.goal: Escalate the Free State conflict to request the aid of the international community.

journalEntries.reason: We have joined the colonial powers vying for control over the African continent, determined to carve out our own colonial empire.

journalEntries.name: The Acquisition of Alaska
journalEntries.reason: Situated in the far North, … is a vast, uncharted territory that may hold many riches. Acquiring the territory will expand our borders greatly, advance our national prestige, and allow for dominating trade in the northern Pacific.

journalEntries.name: The Indochina Campaign
journalEntries.reason: The persecution of the Catholic minority by local powers in the Indochina region has given us a casus belli to intervene. We must assert our authority in this contentious region, and make particular effort to make those powers which persecute Catholics submit to our will.

journalEntries.name: The Nations of Turtle Island
journalEntries.reason: For ourselves and our brothers to survive, we must band together. Only united will we be able to resist the advances, both diplomatic and forceful, of the colonizing powers on our doorsteps.

…, an isolated territory on the periphery of …, has come under threat of seizure by hostile foreign powers in recent years.

journalEntries.name: The Veiled Protectorate
journalEntries.reason: Our influence in Egypt has grown considerably, yet our power in the region is dependent on our relations with the unrecognized state. By establishing a protectorate over the country, our domination would be assured.

journalEntries.name: The Warlord Era
journalEntries.reason:
The collapse of central government authority has led to the rise of various competing military powers across China. If we are to restore China from the ruins, we must establish ourselves as something more than just another Warlord State.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, less powerful Warlord States will be more likely to assist one another against more powerful states.

journalEntries.name: German National Identity
journalEntries.reason: The ideas of nationalism are spreading like wildfire among the German people. Once these ideals have reached a critical mass of followers in the disparate states of the German Confederation, there is bound to be a push for national unification.

journalEntries.name: German Unification
journalEntries.reason: The time has come to make a decisive push for German unification. As one of the foremost German states, it is our duty to bring about this goal.

journalEntries.name: North German Confederation
journalEntries.reason: The age of nationalism is upon us, and the German people seek unification. We must strive to be the foremost power in northern Germany, so that the people look to us as champions of the cause.

journalEntries.name: South German Federation
journalEntries.reason: The age of nationalism is upon us, and the German people seek unification. We must strive to be the foremost power in southern Germany, so that the people look to us as champions of the cause.

journalEntries.name: The Schleswig-Holstein Question
journalEntries.reason: The Schleswig-Holstein Question is currently occupying the thoughts and energies of the German nationalists. In order for Germany to progress towards national unification, the German people of Holstein must first be liberated from their Danish overlords.

journalEntries.name: The Iberian Union
journalEntries.reason:
As the German peoples strive for a unified Germany and the Italians aspire towards Italy, so too do the myriad peoples of the Iberian peninsula look towards a united …. …

The official endorsement of unification by one or more of the peninsula's powers has transformed a unified Iberia from a distant dream to an imminently achievable goal—if all the peninsula's powers can be brought into alignment.

All Countries Involved in this Journal Entry are broadly receptive to some form of Unification. For the peninsula to be diplomatically unified, all of its polities must harmonize their Laws, and possess compatible Governance Principles.

journalEntries.name: Great Eastern Crisis
journalEntries.reason:
A crisis is brewing in the …, with Secessionists jeopardizing the rule of … over the region. As the situation becomes more dire, the …s seek to stabilize the unrest before it consumes the entire region. Meanwhile, opportunistic subjects and foreign powers eye its now-vulnerable Balkan territories.

Waves of Discord:
While the Great Eastern Crisis is ongoing, all Cultural and Religious Political Movements in the … will draw even more #tooltip:…,eastern_crisis_movement_attraction_tt support.

journalEntries.name: Gründerzeit
journalEntries.reason:
An investment craze has gripped the German lands, as capital floods into railways, factories, and banks with feverish intensity—driven by boundless optimism, speculative ambition, and the promise of a new industrial age. Speculators gleefully stake fortunes on targets that grow more fanciful by the day. How long may this atmosphere of euphoria last?

journalEntries.name: Springtime of the Peoples
journalEntries.reason:
Discontent with the post-Napoleonic reactionary order has exploded into a tidal wave of … sentiment across Europe. Liberal revolutionaries hoist tricolor flags, and cry out for liberty, equality, and fraternity.

The death of King Ferdinand VII in 1833 has left Spain embroiled in a succession crisis. The Pragmatic Sanction of 1830 paved the way to the throne for his daughter Isabella in the Spanish Kingdom, in which succession had traditionally been handled through Salic law.
This act angered conservative elements of the aristocracy who held up the kings brother Carlos as the rightful heir instead.

Quickly this materialized into several disparate rebellions under the label of Carlismo, that found its predominant powerbase in the north of the country, particularly amongst the Basque Estates of the Kingdom of Navarra that had been fighting against further centralization of the state and the subsumption of their customs for decades.
Under the leadership of Tomás de Zumalacárregui, these rebels were shaped into a formidable fighting force and could threaten the capital if allowed to unify with their allies in the Maestrazgo and Catalonia.

Despite its subjugation by the Satsuma, the court at Shuri has continued to receive investiture from … and dispatch tribute missions to Beijing, preserving the appearance of independence.

This arrangement has endured for generations; however, the balance of power in East Asia has shifted with the growing presence of western powers and the opening of Japan. Both parties must now clarify their relation to Ryukyu, triggering an open contest for the southern islands.

The revolutionary surge of the Springtime of the Peoples have swept a new liberal government into power in …. To acquire power, however, is not the same as maintaining it. The liberal government is threatened by both conservative forces who wish to abolish the new parliamentary order, and radicals who threaten a second, much more comprehensive revolution.

journalEntries.reason: The … silk industry has been afflicted on a large scale by pébrine, an epidemic which threatens to decimate our silkworm farms if left unchecked.

journalEntries.name: The Red Scare
journalEntries.reason:
The emergence of a powerful communist regime in a foreign country has aroused fears amongst certain segments of the population that … will be the next to fall to communism.

Domestic political currents with left-wing agendas have fallen under the scrutiny of anti-communist forces, as they are accused of being harbingers of bloody revolution, and agents of foreign powers.

journalEntries.name: The Ripper: Murderer at Large
journalEntries.reason: A dangerous killer is stalking the streets of … and terrifying the people of …. We must do all in our power to catch the criminal before he kills again.

journalEntries.name: Annex Oregon
journalEntries.reason: Since the British have refused to cede Oregon diplomatically, we must take it by force of arms.

journalEntries.name: Manifest Destiny: Frontier Wars
journalEntries.reason: We intend for the Great Plains to become a new homeland for the American people. Its current inhabitants must be brought firmly under control.

journalEntries.name: Manifest Destiny: Mexican Cession
journalEntries.reason: It is our destiny to stretch our territory from the Atlantic to the Pacific. From sea to shining sea!

journalEntries.name: Texan Statehood
journalEntries.reason: We observe the conflict between Mexico and Texas with great interest. Should the Texan Republic emerge triumphant, we should try to sway them towards joining our righteous union.

journalEntries.name: The First Transcontinental Railway
journalEntries.reason: The railway shall connect us all, from sea to shining sea!

journalEntries.name: The Indian Removal
journalEntries.reason: Settlers want the Cherokee nation to vacate coveted land. The President, in defiance of the Supreme Court, has ordered that the Cherokee nation should migrate to the Indian Territory.

journalEntries.name: The Oregon Border Dispute
journalEntries.reason: The proper location of the Oregon border has long been an undecided matter between Great Britain and the United States. It is high time that this dispute is settled.

journalEntries.name: The Seminole Wars
journalEntries.reason: By the terms of the Adams-Onis Treaty, Florida is ours to govern as we see fit, and by the terms of the Treaty of Payne's Landing the … should be removed to reservations further west. Led by stubborn chiefs, however, they refuse to either submit to our rule or relocate themselves to …. We must find a way to bring Florida fully under our control.
… With the … throne made empty, the newly-declared Provisional Government has set itself to the task of finding a candidate to serve as King.

journalEntries.name: A Saharan Twilight
journalEntries.reason: After the victory in …, a strategic location beyond the horizon has been identified by the experienced generals of the …. Along with its natural resources, this part of Africa will surely aid us in our mission to reclaim the prestige we once possessed.

journalEntries.name: Além-mar Africano
journalEntries.reason:
It would be a great embarrassment and injustice for our centuries-old empire to fall behind that of other powers.

Having already a foothold on the coasts of Africa, we are determined to seize the opportunity and extend the influence of our culture.

Our first campaign aims to establish colonies at the southern ends of the strategic regions of … and …, so we might consider declaring them as our strategic interests if we haven't already. After that, we will focus on connecting the two coasts in the middle. Our colonial specialists are already working on mapping this area, but first, we should make an impact on the region with our newly founded colonies.

journalEntries.goal: Maintain the union of principalities for 10 years
journalEntries.name: All for One
journalEntries.reason: Together, we are stronger. We must preserve the tentative union we have, that from it we may forge a single, great Romania.

journalEntries.name: An Odious Debt
journalEntries.reason:
Declared in 1804, Haiti's independence from … would not only be hard-fought, but also hard-bought. Diplomatically isolated and fearing another invasion, in 1825 the Haitian government agreed to compensate France for its lost property, human souls included, and for damages incurred during the 1804 Haitian Massacre. In return Haiti would receive diplomatic recognition.

The massive 150 million francs indemnity the country was saddled with necessitated the taking out of high interest loans with French private banks, and ever since Haiti has found itself in a downward spiral of increasing indemnity, debt, and interest payments.

If Haiti is to once again be known as the Pearl of the Antilles, our financial obligations must be dealt with, one way or another.

journalEntries.name: Archipelagic Ethnogenesis
journalEntries.reason: The … nation is home to many peoples, who – while sharing a common history – remain distinct from each others in matters of culture and language. If we are to build a strong nation, such minor differences must be swept aside.

journalEntries.name: Autocracy in the Age of Liberty
journalEntries.reason:
\"The pillars of the Bachian system rest upon its four armies: a standing army of soldiers, a sitting army of officials, a kneeling army of priests, and a creeping army of sneaks.\" 

The threat of a revolution from below has necessitated that … conduct its own from above. Through the establishment of a centralized, rational, and effective state apparatus—staffed by loyal and capable bureaucrats—the country will be modernized to meet the challenges of this day and age.

Constitutional Pressure:
If opposition to Austria's neo-absolutist project grows too strong, … will be forced to yield to demands for reform and grant a constitution limiting the powers of the state.

journalEntries.name: Bavarocracy
journalEntries.reason:
Ever since its establishment in 1832, the nascent … kingdom—the first truly independent Greek state since the days of Constantine XI—has been under the thumb of … … and his Bavarian regents.

If the young king wants to prove himself as a worthy ruler of the Hellenes, he will have to take bold steps to manage the Ire of his new subjects.

journalEntries.name: Bilaad al-Siba
journalEntries.reason:
Over the centuries, the holy Makhzen and the uncivilized tribes scattered across our lands have coexisted in a mutually diplomatic relationship without much concern.

With an ambitious dream of becoming the Ottoman Empire of the West, our nation is recognizing the importance of a strong central government with the means to reach every part of its realm.

Recently, our Control over these settled tribes of the deserts and highlands has begun to weaken. We must establish connections and reasons between the two lands and draw them out of their tents into urban life.

journalEntries.name: Central American Dissolution
journalEntries.reason: The Central American States are crying out for independence. Will we give it to them? Soon, they will give us an ultimatum.

journalEntries.name: Change of Tack
journalEntries.reason:
… concedes that it holds coastal lands that are rightfully ours. However it is adamant about keeping … influence out of the Mediterranean. 

If we can convince the Austrians that we have fallen out with our … Orthodox brethren, they could be persuaded to hand back our precious coast.

journalEntries.name: Confederate Canada
journalEntries.reason: The dream of Canadian Confederation must be realized. By becoming economically dominant over our fellow colonies while maintaining good relations with the central government, we can propose the annexation of one of our neighbors.

journalEntries.name: Confederate Canada
journalEntries.reason: We desire that all of the Canadian colonies be merged into one, and for a Canadian nation to emerge. To achieve this we must convince the local colonial administrations that unification is in their best interests.

journalEntries.name: Cuba es España
journalEntries.reason:
Cuba remains loyal to …. So loyal, in fact, that the Reformists amongst the … seek to have … recognised as a formal … province, with adequate representation in the cortes, and white … gentlemen henceforth considered …. Many of the island's …es are sympathetic to their claim.

As Cubanos and Spaniards become further entangled politically and economically, there is a chance that the Reformists dream may come to fruition; Cuba no longer a colony but a truly a part of ….

journalEntries.name: Elevate Buddhism
journalEntries.reason: The Buddhist religious institutions in Japan have strong historical ties to the administrative arm of the Shogunate. Having averted the end of the Shogunate once, strengthening these institutions could help us maintain its power and strengthen religious traditions for Japan not focused on Emperor worship.

journalEntries.name: Equatorial Foothold
journalEntries.reason:
Reinforcing the coastal security of Western Africa and its isolated areas has rekindled our ambition to reclaim our imperial status as a significant power on the continent.

We need to push forward and expand our influence along the coasts of …, as our imperial competitors are also eager to profit from the region's riches.

journalEntries.name: Establishing Yugoslavia
journalEntries.reason:
Prospects for … to establish a unified Yugoslav state are promising. …, …, …, and … peoples alike have vocalized support of this new Major Unification goal.

The successful Nation Formation of Yugoslavia would be of immense benefit, setting our nation up strategically in the international arena, and make our nation a beacon for all South Slavic peoples living under foreign rule.

journalEntries.name: Exploiting the Amazon
journalEntries.reason:
While … and its properties have long been known to us, traditionally its uses have been limited, and consequently commercial demands have been low. However, with the Industrial Revolution in full swing and new uses for … found by the week, calls for increased production have soared.

Steps must be taken to transform the Amazon from an inhospitable jungle into an intensively developed land capable of meeting the demands of commerce.

journalEntries.name: Eye for an Eye
journalEntries.reason:
The last straw to break the camel's back has been pulled by the Anjeran tribesmen local to the … region. They recently carried out a bloody raid on one of our border garrisons.

The … and local subjects of the region demand retribution against these marauders beyond the border to ….

Our national stature will significantly deteriorate if military measures aren't taken promptly.

journalEntries.name: Federate Australia
journalEntries.reason: The Australian people would be best served by unifying the petty provincial governments into a single nation. We must work with lesser administrations as well as the Colonial Office to propose the annexation of our neighbors.

journalEntries.name: Federate Australia
journalEntries.reason: The Australian people would be best served by unifying the petty provincial governments into a single nation. We must work with local colonial governments to ease the process of federation.

journalEntries.name: Foreign Interests
journalEntries.reason: Hawaii's position in the Pacific Ocean makes it extremely valuable for Trans Pacific Trade. We must be sure to placate the local businesses and dissuade any potential great power from wanting to take advantage of our islands.

journalEntries.name: Fracturing Oman
journalEntries.reason: The sons of … are hungry for power and land. Upon the Sultan's death, …'s sons will split the country between its Arabian and African holdings and vie for supremacy.

journalEntries.name: From Rebels to Nation
journalEntries.reason:
The Njegoš family are set on forming a nation out of the violent tribes sitting on the mountain in defiance of the …. Fortunately, … is prepared to help their fellow Orthodox Christians, sending financial aid. The better we can maintain Relations, the more Russian Aid we can count on. 

If a semblance of a state can be founded, and the tribes' raiding kept in check, the Great Powers may force the … to cede territory and recognize us as an independent nation.

journalEntries.name: Hispanoamerica
journalEntries.reason:
We will not waste men and resources in a futile attempt to restore what once was. Instead, cordiality and mutual benefit will define the … relationship with her former colonies. We shall instruct our diplomats to draw up Treaties of Commerce and Friendship with our former subjects, sending a powerful message to the world of our magnanimity.

Formal Recognition
While …'s former colonies in the Americas achieved de facto independence following the Spanish American Wars of Independence in the early 19th century, no de jure recognition of this new status followed.

Until … formally recognizes the independence of her former colonies using the Recognize Independence Treaty Article, bilateral diplomatic relations will remain severely hindered.

journalEntries.name: Hungarian Revolution
journalEntries.reason:
"Liberty is a principle; its community is its security; exclusiveness is its doom"—Lajos Kossuth

As … entered the new century, it would find itself increasingly dominated by cliques of liberal, reform-minded politicians.

While disagreeing on the exact nature of Hungary's future relationship with the Habsburg monarchy, they unite behind a common desire for political and economic reform, intending to transform the relative backwater of Hungary into a modern and dynamic nation state with autonomy over Hungarian Homelands.

Citizens by Compulsion
Should … find itself opposing Austria in a Diplomatic Play, oppressed minorities may take advantage of the situation and try to throw off the Magyar yoke.

journalEntries.name: I, the Supreme
journalEntries.reason:
The eccentric and uncompromising reign of the Supreme and … of …, Doctor …, has dominated most of Paraguay's post-independence period. With the support of his …, the dreaded Pyraguës, Doctor Francia has ruled the country with a firm hand, exchanging his silken glove for an iron fist whenever needed.

But the …'s age is starting to show. And thus, in … there are whispers. Whispers that Francia's vision of an isolationist, Rousseauian paradise, may not survive the good Doctor himself.

journalEntries.name: Independencia
journalEntries.reason:
Cuba's desire for freedom is divided. 

Some seek allies across the Gulf of Mexico, hoping to purchase the island's liberty through American coin, rather than Cuban blood. While on the floors of the cigar factories, men whisper about a free Cuba unbound to any power except the passion and will of its people.

Which path to freedom?
First, the nation must gain enough Liberty Desire, or else freedom from … will be but a dream. Then various #tooltippable;tooltip:…,total_factors_tt factors will lead freedom-seekers to either want to be purchased by the … or seek true independence.

journalEntries.name: Influencing Hawaii
journalEntries.reason: Recent developments in Hawaii have left an opening for the potential to secure the islands and thus bolster our influence in the region. If the Hawaiian Government cannot maintain control, we may be able to step in and secure the islands for ourselves.

journalEntries.name: İnhidam-ı Azîm
journalEntries.reason:
With unrest crawling in the nation's veins, our dominion teeters on the brink, and a show of imperial stratagem will surely remind all our subjects of the might of its former glory.

We must exercise conciliatory expertise to ensure the safety of our borders. Should such trials fail to invert the situation, they will be sundered and the fuse of The Grand Collapse will ignite.

journalEntries.name: La Vida Dulce
journalEntries.reason:
Cuba has come to dominate the sugar trade, largely through the continued smuggling of …. The nation's long term prosperity will depend on expanding these established Trade routes. 

Should slavery be abolished, perhaps one day all Cubanos could benefit from a sweeter life.

journalEntries.name: Lords of the Zanj
journalEntries.reason: Our control of East Africa is more notional than real, but few other nations realize that. Our first priority should be to solidify our hold on our mainland territories, either through diplomatic maneuvering and recognition, or direct conquest and expanding our real presence in the region. If we fail, all of … could unravel overnight.

journalEntries.name: Maghreb's Garden
journalEntries.reason:
Given the success of our recent initiatives in Africa, officials agree that our efforts would be truly fulfilled by acquiring the territories beyond the Strait of Gibraltar.

They also warn us that it would present a new challenge to subdue its inhabitants under our rule, even after conquering the official lands, considering the numerous tribal communities separated from central politics. Nevertheless, we'll turn this part of the Maghreb into our backyard beyond Andalusia by accomplishing this task.

journalEntries.name: Matter of Hungary
journalEntries.reason:
Ever since the Habsburgs first secured the throne of St. Stephen centuries ago, its independent-minded Hungarian subjects have proven a difficult lot to rule.

Confronted by increasingly bellicose demands for … autonomy, the administration in … must decide whether to accede to the demands of the Hungarian nationalists, or to rein them in, by force if need be.

Hungarian Revolution
The activation of the Springtime of the Peoples Journal Entry will likely empower radical factions in the Hungarian Diet, possibly leading to conflict with the government in ….

journalEntries.reason: N/A

journalEntries.name: One and Indivisible
journalEntries.reason:
The union of Hispaniola's western and eastern part; … and …, has not been a happy one. Established through force of arms in 1822, it initially enjoyed some limited support from select elites and Afro-Dominicans. However, …'s policies of heavy taxation, land redistribution, and mass confiscations, combined with anti-Catholic practices and general mismanagement, would soon turn the majority of the population against rule from ….

Unless decisive steps are taken, this discontent is likely to materialize as an armed insurrection in the near future.

journalEntries.name: Our Fortunate Regeneration
journalEntries.reason:
"Above the stagecoach horse is the tramway, above that the locomotive, and above all, progress."
— Fontes Pereira de Melo

There are many who regard … as a nation past its time, one that will never again come close to the glories of its Golden Age. This sense of destitution has led … liberal politicians to dream of a "Regeneration", a period of rapid change that would pull the nation from its stasis and restore its former prestige.

The installation of a unifying regime has transformed this long-desired Regeneration from an ideal to a reality. The government has presented plans for ambitious institutional reforms. If completed, they promise to reverse the long decline of …—and build the base for an unbreakable liberal order.

journalEntries.name: Perla del Mar de Oriente
journalEntries.reason:
Upward mobility from the burgeoning middle class has contributed to a growing national consciousness. Tensions within the … are on the rise. … … dominate secular and religious life, while … … lead revolts against their authority. … elites of the …, too, are maneuvering for greater representation in government.

Ultimately, the … government has high expectations that the … maintains an iron rule over their territory out in the Pacific. This friction threatens to topple our stability, putting the future of the … at risk.

journalEntries.name: Prisoner of the Red Fort
journalEntries.reason:
The lords of … once ruled from Kabul to the Carnatic coast, but that golden age has long since passed. …'s power steadily grows, each year asserting new prerogatives of its own and denying our court more and more of the authority, prestige, and traditions it once enjoyed. Now the great scions of Timur scarcely wield any power beyond the walls of the Red Fort of Delhi!

We must act to save …, lest it slide into oblivion.

journalEntries.name: Prussia of the Balkans
journalEntries.reason:
The Bulgarian Empire once stretched from the Black to the Ionian and Aegean Seas. Our people are determined to restore our past glory. 

Our newly reborn nation cannot rely on the help of strong men from outside our borders. Through technology, strength of arms and sheer numbers, we will forge an army that can protect our independence, our interests, and our ambitions.

journalEntries.name: Raiding
journalEntries.reason:
With little arable land and no industry to speak of, the Montenigrin tribes turn to Raiding Ottoman territory to survive. 

While the Montenegrin tribesmen proudly put the severed heads of Ottomans on display, … has begun to take a low view of such activities. 

Meanwhile, if we raid too excessively, the … may use this to justify their own aggressive action. 

Raiding:
We are earning … due to our army's Power Projection of … and a Raiding Fervor of …%.

The more we earn from raiding, the more likely the … are to counterattack, unless they are at war.

journalEntries.name: Reconquista
journalEntries.reason:
In our moment of greatest need, when the armies of the accursed marshal burned their way through our lands, ingrates and radicals of the lowest sort seized the opportunity to cast away the love and protection of their madre patria.

These misguided fools must learn to know the consequences of their actions. For … is eternal, and her domain over the New World will be restored.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: National Institutions
journalEntries.reason:
For years, … liberal politicians have dreamt of a "Regeneration" - an ambitious program to construct the physical and legal infrastructure that will serve as a basis for national development. The relative political stability that … has achieved has created an opportunity to realize these many reforms.

The state itself - the framework within which contracts are enforced, funds allocated, and a stable environment ensured - is central to the program of Regeneration. To construct a modern state, a modern population is needed - one that is educated, competent, and patriotic. A new generation of jurists, clerks, and officers will fill the ranks of the bureaucracy, and create the institutions needed for further development.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: Public Works
journalEntries.reason:
For years, … liberal politicians have dreamt of a "Regeneration" - an ambitious program to construct the physical and legal infrastructure that will serve as a basis for national development. The relative political stability that … has achieved has created an opportunity to realize these many reforms.

Mainland … is a rough, sparsely-populated land, with many isolated regions and underdeveloped lines of communication. When one takes its overseas Empire into account, the problem of transportation acquires a new level of urgency. The telegraph and the railway are regarded by the politicians of Regeneration as the very embodiment of progress - technologies which will bind nation and empire together more than they have ever been before.

journalEntries.name: Regeneration: The Countryside
journalEntries.reason:
For years, … liberal politicians have dreamt of a "Regeneration" - an ambitious program to construct the physical and legal infrastructure that will serve as a basis for national development. The relative political stability that … has achieved has created an opportunity to realize these many reforms.

The inefficient and antiquated nature of … agriculture has long served as a brake on development. The countryside is the realm of vast, inefficient noble estates and church lands which make use of techniques unchanged for centuries. If Regeneration is to come to the countryside, it must come alongside the use of new technologies and more entrepreneurial forms of land ownership.

journalEntries.name: Restoration: The … Mission
journalEntries.reason:
As part of its modernizing measures, the new government of … has sent … and a sizable entourage of ministers and scholars upon a diplomatic mission across the Western world. The … Mission seeks to renegotiate unequal treaties with the West, and conduct inquiries into the political and technological foundations of the Great Powers.

For each month the Mission remains in a country, there will be a chance that it collects findings on that country's Laws or Technologies. These findings will affect the report the Mission will issue upon its return, as well as the Ideology of the expedition leader.

journalEntries.name: Risorgimento
journalEntries.reason:
The winds of nationalism sweeping Europe have begun to pass through …, inspiring figures both within our government and without to look towards the restoration of a single, unified Italy.

Whilst this journal entry is active, having any active Revolution caused by an … will lead to the seizure of the … government by pan-Italian revolutionaries….

journalEntries.name: Second Liberalism
journalEntries.reason:
The Liberal Revolution of 1820 ushered in the era of constitutional rule in …, beginning what is referred to as the "First Liberalism". Though King Miguel I was briefly able to restore absolutism, his defeat in the Liberal Wars and subsequent exile has made constitutional rule a fact.

Though every level of the … government is now filled by ex-revolutionaries, from the moderate … tendency to progressive Radicals, the precise identity of this "Second Liberalism" is yet undefined. Will the stabilizing compromises of the moderates carry the day, or will the spirit of 1820 roar back to life?

journalEntries.name: Serbia and Montenegro
journalEntries.reason:
The people of … have always seen themselves as Serbs tragically separated from their brethren in … by the tyrannical …. 

If both states were free and shared a common border, they could unite as one great Serbian nation.

journalEntries.name: Shinbutsu Bunri
journalEntries.reason: With the power of the Emperor restored, we need to distinguish and uplift the native religious traditions which hold the imperial line sacred. To accomplish this, they need to be separated from the foreign influence of Buddhism, which has been inextricably linked with kami worship for hundreds of years through syncretic traditions. Leveraging discontent with Buddhist institutions from its connections with the Shogunate, we can make way for Shinto as the higher guiding principle.

journalEntries.name: Si Vis Pacem, Fac Bellum
journalEntries.reason:
"If you want peace, make war."

A contradiction to some perhaps, but to … … it is a statement of fact. Around us, our neighbors maneuver and scheme, plotting to wrest control of our sacred lands from us.
Should then, we meekly wait for the enemy to make the first move? Or pray to the Almighty they never do?

No. As our forefathers before us, we must make our own luck. If war must come to …, let it come on our terms.

journalEntries.name: Sikh Sovereignty
journalEntries.reason:
These are the early days of our newly established dynasty. Our burgeoning kingdom has enjoyed great success in the years since the Sher-e-Punjab conquered the former Mughal imperial capital.

It is critical at this time that we protect our territory from outside aggression and honor the tenets of our … faith. May the legacy of this dynasty be long-lasting!

Empire Stability and Court Intrigue
The … faces more than just external threats. Forces within our court may conspire to overthrow our Ruler in favor of their preferred candidate. If our Court Intrigue reaches 100%, our … (Ruler) will be assassinated, Empire Stability will be reset to 0, Intrigue will decrease, and a new candidate will be enthroned.

journalEntries.name: Spoils of War
journalEntries.reason:
Only a couple of days after the declaration of victory, all remaining Balkan League members have turned their gaze upon what they claim to be unjustly distributed lands conquered from the Ottomans.

High-ranking officers and politicians alike, including ours, are demanding amends while the iron of war is already heated.

journalEntries.name: Struggle for Independence
journalEntries.reason: The apathy of Brazil's imperial government towards the plight of its people can no longer be tolerated. We have elected our own government and declared ourselves an independent republic!

journalEntries.name: Struggle for Sovereignty
journalEntries.reason:
Our great … … may rule over … but we are still subject to the whims and folly of …. …'s power grows day by day, but we can still shape our fate.

The tides are in our favor to increase …'s autonomy and pursue a path for independence, lest the … take full control.

journalEntries.name: Struggle for the Highveld
journalEntries.reason: The interior lands of the veld appear to be inhospitable scrubland at first glance, but there are fertile grounds among the fields, and the escarpments glitter invitingly. Order—our order—must be put in place, to ensure this rich land can see the peace it so dearly needs to reveal its full potential.

journalEntries.name: Taming the North
journalEntries.reason:
With the formation of the … Development Commission, commonly known as the Kaitakushi, this former frontier is abuzz with activity. Every day … arrive from the south, seeking new lands and opportunities.

Yet this is no ordinary rush of peoples. For with the settlers come bureaucrats, intellectuals, and modernizing visionaries with a mission to shape the land—eager to see their vision of …'s future manifested in the … of today.

journalEntries.name: Tenpō Crisis
journalEntries.reason:
Declared in 1830, the Tenpō, or 'Heavenly Protection' Era initially lived up to its auspicious name. However, poor weather conditions on … would soon result in soaring rice prices and a country-wide famine, while the increasing wealth and influence of the … threatens the established … order.

Meanwhile, on the horizon, Western Great Powers are getting ever bolder, and their merchantmen and gunboats ever closer to our shores.

Seeking to address these issues, reform-minded notables have outlined their visions to the Bakufu.

journalEntries.reason:
After years of cultural and political turmoil between us and Mexico, with the rights of our citizens having been increasingly curtailed, it is time for us to rise up!
The days of our glorious lands being beholden to the tyrannical Mexican regime is coming to an end.

journalEntries.name: The Acre Dispute
journalEntries.reason: The region of … has become heavily disputed. Opportunistic … settlers seek to claim the land for themselves, and demand action - we must strike while the iron is hot.

The aftermath of the Napoleonic Wars has established … as a leading conservative power in Europe. The leading architect of the post-Napoleonic order, …, has served as Chancellor of … since the tumultuous year of 1821. … agenda calls for upholding the … …, the maintenance of the conservative peace in Europe, and the promotion of the arts and sciences.

journalEntries.name: The Age of Princes
journalEntries.reason: Ethiopia has been shattered into a dozen warring fiefdoms. It is up to us to reunify the Empire and to restore peace and prosperity to our people.

journalEntries.name: The Algerian War of Resistance
journalEntries.reason: In 1830, the Deylik of Algiers fell to the accursed French. Their victory however, was not complete, and the Algerian interior remains unbroken. With the aid of God, we shall push the invaders back into the sea, and consolidate the three Beyliks under our benevolent rule.

journalEntries.name: The Balkan League
journalEntries.reason:
Now that the Balkan nations are free from the grasp of the High Porte, there is a consensus of forming an alliance to push them back once and for all. However, such consensus will not last forever, and our window of opportunity is limited. 

It is the hope of all our nations that the … will one day belong to its authentic inhabitants!

journalEntries.name: The Canadian Pacific Railway
journalEntries.reason: A railway spanning from the Atlantic to the Pacific coast would open up new opportunities for settlement in Western Canada.

journalEntries.name: The Conquest of the Desert
journalEntries.reason: The southern reaches of the continent remain outside of the control of any nation. Though the native population will certainly not make it easy, it is imperative that we secure this territory before it falls into the hands of our rivals.

journalEntries.name: The Corporate Empire
journalEntries.reason:
The rapid industrialization of … has brought much of the economy under the umbrella of the Zaibatsu. Profiting handsomely from their entanglement with state institutions, these enterprises have become vital organs within the military-industrial structure of Japan.

The concentrated nature of … capital has made the country an international competitor, at the price of placing ever-greater political power in the hands of the Zaibatsu and their military patrons.…

journalEntries.reason:
The Montenegrins believe themselves to be an independent state, when in fact they are our subjects given a degree of autonomy in order to practice their religious freedom. For too long they have been tolerated, killing our tax collectors and harming our people. 

If we were to put them to the sword, it would send a message to other rebels in our lands. However, we must be cautious, lest the Great Powers become involved, and small … becomes the match that ignites the powder keg of Europe.

journalEntries.reason:
Donghak, or Eastern Learning, has begun to spread amongst the … of … as a response to the opening of the country to the outside world. Followers of Donghak, often affiliated with the …, advocate for equality and rights for all, and a rejection of foreign influence.

The infrastructure that followers of Donghak have created spreads throughout the country, and may serve as a means to rapidly organize rebellion in the future.

journalEntries.goal: The Goal is clear to us.
journalEntries.name: The Dreyfus Affair
journalEntries.reason:
Since the publication of "J'Accuse...!", a growing discord has been threatening to tear the social and political fabric of France asunder. What started as a debate about the innocence of a single man has taken on far greater dimensions:

Monarchists pitted against republicans, liberals against conservatives, and devout Catholics against secularists. All attempting to settle the question once and for all: Is our country the France of St. Louis, or the France of Voltaire?

journalEntries.name: The Federal Project
journalEntries.reason:
The government of … has endorsed a proposal to reorganize the territories of the … Empire into a federation of self-governing states drawn along ethnic lines. This proposal would abolish the complex network of crown-lands and personal unions currently forming the Empire, replacing them with a federal structure ultimately accountable to Vienna.

If … completes the The Federal Solution Journal Entry, the traditional rights and privileges of … will be abolished, and our lands integrated directly into the ….

journalEntries.name: The Federal Solution
journalEntries.reason:
Friction between the myriad nationalities of … has long been a danger to the integrity of the Empire. Advocates for the rights of various nationalities have long called for various forms of federalization for the Empire, and recent years have brought them in contact with members of the … interested in radical reform in the name of upholding the dynasty. The proposed United States of Greater Austria, the most recent of these proposals, would abolish the old crownlands, and replace them with a selection of self-governing states drawn along ethnic lines.

This proposal has been met with opposition from … politicians who oppose its proposed division of historical Hungary, as well as the … populations which would likely become minorities within non-German states.

"Industry and commerce will see marked development under good governance and peace. We are absolutely certain that peace in East Asia will as a result have stronger foundations than ever before."
— Record of the Emperor Meiji, Volume 12

The time has come to establish a permanent presence in the Korean Peninsula. Only then can we ensure the future prosperity and safety of … and all of …. In order to properly secure control, we must oversee the development of … and not waver in our ambition.

journalEntries.name: The Hanoverian Succession
journalEntries.reason: The personal union between Great Britain and Hanover rests upon unstable ground. Different laws of succession guarantee that the union will end upon the death of King William, with the British throne passing to Princess Victoria.

journalEntries.name: The Heart of America
journalEntries.reason:
Long did the nation of … languish under the arbitrary rule of Francia. But where the old tyrant wanted Paraguay to retreat from the world stage, … … instead desires for Paraguay to shine on it.

Concerned about the nation's precarious military and economic situation, … has instigated an ambitious program to modernize and expand its armed forces. After all, only they may truly safeguard the interests of the nation, wherever they may lie.

journalEntries.name: The Heavenly Revolution
journalEntries.reason: The people have risen against the devilry and corruption of …. The …'s rule must be extinguished, and a new era of heavenly peace brought to China.

journalEntries.name: The Internacionalistas
journalEntries.reason:
The destitution and political tension endemic to … has created fertile soil for the growth of the …. Anarchist agitators have found a solid base of support amongst those whose livelihoods have been made precarious by the modernization of Spain.

From the mills of … to the Southern villages packed with destitute day-laborers, work-weary faces turn to those with fiery eyes and powder-stained fingers. They listen, and learn—and, given the barest chance, they will act.

journalEntries.name: The Kraków Uprising
journalEntries.reason: The Revolution tearing through the free city of … threatens to unleash another wave of Polish nationalist agitation in Galicia. The city must be pacified, and incorporated as a full component of ….

journalEntries.name: The Locked Country
journalEntries.reason: Since the Kan'ei era and the earliest days of Tokugawa power, Japan has been a country closed to outsiders. A trickle of trade with a few select nations at a few designated ports is all that has ever been allowed. While this system has lasted for more than two centuries, the world is beginning to change in ways that make it harder to keep the country locked down, even if interests within Japan wish things could remain the same forever. If foreign attempts to open our lands cannot be stopped, then we must import their ideas as well as their goods.

journalEntries.name: The Megali Idea
journalEntries.reason:
"The Greek is not only he who inhabits the kingdom, but also he who lives in Janina, or Thessaloniki, or Seres, or Adrianople, or Constantinople, or Trebizone, or Crete, or Samos, or any other country of the Greek history or race..."
—Ioannis Kolettis

Despite the establishment of an independent Greek state, most Greeks still live under foreign rule. A concerted effort must be made, through both diplomatic and military means, to incorporate all of … into our government.…

journalEntries.name: The Old Empire
journalEntries.reason: Since our recognition of its independence in 1825, the former … colony of … has dominated the South American continent. Though the brief period of post-independence personal union under King and Emperor Pedro IV and I ended in failure, cultural ties between Portugal and Brazil remain strong. These existing ties present a prime opportunity for establishing a lasting economic and diplomatic relationship.

journalEntries.name: The Old Metropole
journalEntries.reason:
While … both appears and acts as a fully sovereign nation, our standing in the eyes of the world will forever remain uncertain as long as our former overlords withhold recognition. We should strive to establish good relations with Madrid, or present such a mighty visage to the world that none may dare to question our legitimacy.

Formal Recognition
While Spain's former colonies in the Americas achieved de facto independence following the Spanish American Wars of Independence in the early 19th century, no de jure recognition of this new status followed.

Until Spain formally recognizes the independence of her former colonies using the Recognize Independence Treaty Article, bilateral diplomatic relations will remain severely hindered.

journalEntries.name: The Paraguayan War
journalEntries.reason:
The … serpent has reared its ugly head. … … has laid out … ambitions for the world to see, ambitions that would greatly upset the South American balance of power.

The consensus is clear, only an armed response will deter … now. The only question is, should we offer one?

journalEntries.name: The Paris Commune
journalEntries.reason: A selection of socialist, anarchist, and radical republican revolutionaries have occupied the city of Paris, declaring a rival government over France.

journalEntries.name: The Paris Commune
journalEntries.reason:
A selection of socialist, anarchist, and radical republican revolutionaries have occupied the city of Paris, declaring a rival government over ….

As long as the … continues to exist, it represents a drastic threat to our government. If the progress of the Commune reaches 0, our forces will be able to repress it, but if its progress reaches 100 the revolutionaries shall carry out a march on Versailles, ending our government entirely. If a Revolution breaks out whilst this rival government exists, it will swear fealty to the ….

journalEntries.name: The Paris Commune
journalEntries.reason:
The proletariat of Paris have risen and occupied the capital, declaring a rival government over ….

As long as our … continues to exist, it represents a drastic threat to the bourgeois government in Versailles. If the progress of the Commune reaches 100, our forces shall be able to carry out a march on Versailles, ending our rival government entirely, but if its progress reaches 0, the Versailles government shall invade Paris, ending our government entirely.

The effects of this journal entry will contribute … to our treasury every week.

journalEntries.name: The Pink Map
journalEntries.reason:
With multiple colonies successfully established on east and west coasts of Africa, we can take the opportunity to connect them with a corridor in the belly of the continent.

We have developed a proposal called The Pink Map, which outlines our goals for which areas to colonize. Accomplishing such a goal will evolve us into an unmatchable power in the colonial race.

journalEntries.name: The Reign of the Devourers
journalEntries.reason:
The conclusive victory of the Liberals in the Portuguese Civil War has banished the pretender King Miguel to Rome, and rendered his supporters a spent force in domestic politics. In the aftermath, the dominant … faction of the Liberals have set about solidifying their monopoly on power - and their unimpeded access to the … treasury.

Over the past year, the Cartist government has embarked upon a sweeping program of selling national properties to private investors, a policy that has been named "Devorismo", or "Devourism" by its detractors. These privatizations, far from meaningfully alleviating …'s substantial debts, have led to a concentration of property in the hands of wealthy supporters of the Liberals, and contributed to a split in … liberalism that grows wider and wider by the day.

journalEntries.name: The South Atlantic Slave Trade
journalEntries.reason:
Despite the signing of the British-Brazilian Treaty of 1826, whereby … pledged itself to the abolition of the African slave trade, little effort has since been expended by … authorities to actually enforce it.

Instead, … slavers continue to ferry tens of thousands of African souls across the Atlantic in chains every year, making a mockery of Whitehall's good name and reputation.

This cannot stand. One way or another, … shall yield.

journalEntries.name: The Ständestaat
journalEntries.reason:
The rise of mass politics in … has spurred the rise of a counter-movement amongst the traditional classes. The … seeks to abolish … and multiparty democracy in favor of a …, or "Ständestaat".

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, the rate at which … characters appear will be increased.

journalEntries.name: The Status of the Vernacular
journalEntries.reason:
For centuries, the … Homelands have been home to many …. Considered distinct cultures and languages in their own right by some and nothing but corrupted variants of true … by others, their prevalence has sparked fierce discussions on the 'vernacular issue' in ….

With some arguing that the nation cannot hope to be truly united before regionalism is stamped out, other counter with arguments that … never has been, and never can be anything but an amalgamation of regional tongues and identities, none inherently superior to the other.

journalEntries.name: The Two Spains
journalEntries.reason:
The Progress Bar will drift towards #tooltippable;tooltip:…,two_spains_liberal_pivot_factors_tt …/#tooltippable;tooltip:…,two_spains_conservative_pivot_factors_tt … over time.
