"Here lies half of Spain. It died of the other half."
—Mariano José de Larra

Since the War of Independence, … has been trapped in an oft-violent struggle between "the two Spains", the first loyal to Church and Crown, and the second to Enlightenment and Constitution. The irreconcilable hostility of the two sides, born of an underdeveloped liberal project, has entrenched a political order that relies upon the Army more than the ballot. If … is to find peace, she must choose which vision is to define her.

journalEntries.name: The United Kingdom
journalEntries.reason:
From 1807 to 1821, the court of … ruled from Rio de Janeiro. In an attempt to accommodate … concerns, King João VI elevated Brazil to the status of a co-equal Kingdom, forming the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil, and the Algarves. Though the independence of Brazil ended the first United Kingdom, Portugal and Brazil were, soon after, placed under a brief personal union under King and Emperor Pedro IV and I.

The recent resurgence of Portuguese power, and current positive atmosphere between us and our former colony, have raised hopes of restoring the United Kingdom. If the Brazilian succession laws are amended, these hopes may become a reality.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, we will be able to sign a Treaty to Amend Succession Laws with …, laying the groundwork for a future Personal Union.

journalEntries.name: Unite the Principalities
journalEntries.reason: The Danubian principalities have roused from their long lethargy. The rights and interests of the homeland cry out for liberation; the good and happiness of the Romanian nation demands action! We must pursue union, and help build a single country for our people. Caution must be exercised, however—we cannot upset any Great Powers in the process.

journalEntries.name: A Colonial Power
journalEntries.reason: Our first steps to establishing our hegemony should be to expand our borders overseas. We should amend our laws to allow us to colonize, in order to further our goals.

journalEntries.name: A Great Power
journalEntries.reason: We have been a regional power, but now we should look to solidify our standing in the world and join the other Great Powers as a show of our might.

journalEntries.name: Achieve Sovereignty
journalEntries.reason:
As long as we are not recognized as an equal by the wider international community, foreign meddling in our domestic affairs will remain endemic.

We should strive to stake out a place for ourselves at their table, so that our nation does not go the way of Old Chorasmia.

journalEntries.name: Acquire Manchurian Concessions
journalEntries.reason: The region of Manchuria contains several areas which may serve as valuable warm-water ports. Acquiring treaty concessions and constructing railways in the region will immensely benefit our power projection in the Pacific Ocean.

journalEntries.name: African Colonies
journalEntries.reason: Now that our laws allow us to establish our own colonies, we should look towards acquiring new lands on the African Continent as our first steps in expanding our hegemony.

journalEntries.name: An Egalitarian Society
journalEntries.reason:
Now that we have all the laws and institutions in place, we should look to making sure that we have an equal society that allows for equal opportunities for all our citizens. Our nation should be seen as a shining beacon that will lead the world on an Egalitarian Path.

NOTE: Regressing any of the laws passed in the previous Journal Entries will result in this Journal being hidden and you will be unable to progress further through this objective until the law is enacted again.

journalEntries.name: Bolstering the Military
journalEntries.reason: With our first colonies established, we should be prepared for the worst. Our army doesn't need to be the strongest in the world, but we should aim to dissuade others from attempting a Diplomatic Play against us.

journalEntries.name: Codify the Chinese Border
journalEntries.reason: Our border with China is both long and unformalized. Seeking to draw a formal border between our state and China could permit generous transfers of land into our control, and a minimal risk of future border conflicts.

journalEntries.name: Consolidate Afghanistan
journalEntries.reason: The ill-defined borders of Afghanistan present opportunity for a crisis and devastating war in the Pamirs. In order to stabilize the border between ourselves and our opponent, we must collaborate to solidify an Afghan state.

journalEntries.name: Consolidate Central Asian Holdings
journalEntries.reason: The region of Central Asia has long been out of our control, run by disparate khanates and emirates. In order to secure access to India, we must ensure that the Central Asian states are subjugated, whether as Subjects or through direct conquest.

journalEntries.name: Consolidate Persia
journalEntries.reason:
Governmental control of the Persian provinces have long been of a tenuous nature, with autonomous sheikhdoms and foreign powers holding more sway than the nominal governors appointed by ….

If we are to effectively modernize the state, the sovereignty of the central government must be enforced.

journalEntries.name: Contest the Russian Pamirs
journalEntries.reason:
The recent Russian expansion into the Pamir mountains presents an intolerable threat to our interests in India. The creation of a buffer state in Tajikistan would humiliate Russia and grant our interests south of Pamir some breathing room, at the cost of a high risk of direct war between Russia and Great Britain.

This option should be explored cautiously.

journalEntries.name: Counter Russian Pacific Influence
journalEntries.reason: The Russian acquisition of quality ports on their Pacific coast represents an unacceptable risk of losing naval dominance in the north Pacific. To contain their influence in the region, we must seek a reliable ally amongst the independent powers of the region.

journalEntries.name: Disrupt the Russian Caucasus
journalEntries.reason: The fledgling state of Circassia, located on the Black Sea in the Caucasus region, presents an opportunity to arrest Russian consolidation in the region. Extending recognition to the Circassian state, and ensuring its continued existence, must be a priority of ours.

journalEntries.name: Encourage Liberal Thought
journalEntries.reason: The first steps to creating any form of Egalitarian Society should be to get the right people in government. With them in a position to enact change, we can take our first steps towards a more equal society.

journalEntries.name: Expand British India
journalEntries.reason: The existence of independent states on the fringes of the … represents opportunity to expand and enrich our colonies in the region, as well as remove possible avenues for our opponents to threaten the highly profitable lands of India.

journalEntries.goal: Increase … in … by one level.
journalEntries.name: Expand our Mining Industries
journalEntries.reason: We should take our first steps towards increasing our domestic output. We should expand the … in …. This will place us in a strong position to expand industries further in the future.

journalEntries.name: Expanding our Market
journalEntries.reason: We should look to expanding our Customs Union with additional nations. This will allow for freer and more direct trade with other nations, without the need to Trade with the World Market.

journalEntries.goal: Secure our interest in Tibet
journalEntries.name: Expedition to Tibet
journalEntries.reason: In our great game against our rivals, one realm stands above the rest in its potential value and threat: Tibet. We find ourselves driven to protect our flank and deny our enemy's ambitions by securing our interests in this Himalayan land.

journalEntries.name: Exporting Our Profits
journalEntries.reason:
Now that we have a large stockpile of goods, we can begin exporting these goods as to increase the profitability of their production buildings.

NOTE: Completing this journal entry will invalidate the Improving Production journal entry.

journalEntries.name: Form Alliances
journalEntries.reason: Maintaining a powerful army is important, but it is not the only way we can maintain our security. We should also create alliances with other powers around the globe that can come to our aid in case another nation wishes to attempt to take what is rightfully ours.

journalEntries.name: Improving Production
journalEntries.reason:
With our production of industrialized products now well under way we should look to reinvest these goods back into our other buildings. We will then be able to free up other workers to work elsewhere.

NOTE: Completing this journal entry will invalidate the Exporting our Profits journal entry.

journalEntries.name: Increasing Export Value
journalEntries.reason: With our focus now being placed on the exportation of our valuable goods, the best course of action would be to increase the value of these goods to maximize the profits the buildings are earning.

journalEntries.name: Liberate the Slaves
journalEntries.reason: How can we even begin to call ourselves an Egalitarian Society when we are still in the active practice of utilizing slavery within in our nation? It is vital that our first step should be to put a stop to this outdated and immoral practice.

journalEntries.name: Lowering Consumption Prices
journalEntries.reason: With our growing industries not only do we need to maintain a steady stream of goods into our factories, we also need to check that these input goods are not too expensive and negatively affecting production of additional more valuable goods.

journalEntries.name: Maintain Subjects
journalEntries.reason: With our power solidified, we should expand our sphere of influence over other nations. Subjugating a few nations will go a long way in increasing our influence on the international stage.

journalEntries.name: Major Power
journalEntries.reason: We have never been the strongest, but that changes now! We will show the world we aren't some tiny speck of land off in the distance whose tiny voice should be ignored.

journalEntries.name: Pacify the Kazakh Steppe
journalEntries.reason: Despite formally extending our authority over the various Kazakh Khanates in the early eighteenth century, effectively governing the Kazakh steppe has proven difficult. Our re-organization of the region in 1828 has officially replaced each former Khan with a Russian-appointed Agha-Sultan, but the issue of banditry and widespread discontent with their rule remains. To resolve this, the three Zhuzes must be successfully pacified and brought under direct Russian rule.

journalEntries.name: Passing Laws
journalEntries.reason:
Now that we have a more powerful liberal element in our government, we should look to using their influence in passing more egalitarian laws.

NOTE: Regressing any of these laws after completing this Journal will result in this Journal being hidden until the law is enacted again.

journalEntries.name: Public Services
journalEntries.reason:
With our laws in place we should look to expand our Institutions so that they can become more readily available and accessible to our population.

NOTE: Regressing any of the laws passed in the previous Journal Entries will result in this Journal being hidden and you will be unable to progress further through this objective until the law is enacted again.

journalEntries.name: Recognized Power
journalEntries.reason: Shunned by so-called "civilized" powers, through toil and struggle we shall prove our worth to them, and secure for ourselves a respected place among the fellowship of nations.

journalEntries.name: Refining our Production
journalEntries.reason: Having increased our raw Goods production, we should now look to refine these Goods to increase potential for profits across our nation. Why import from others when we can make it ourselves?

journalEntries.name: Secure a Korean Protectorate
journalEntries.reason: The Korean Peninsula represents an opportunity for further expansion of our influence into East Asia and the Pacific Ocean. A properly developed Korea under our supervision could rival Japan, and serve to bolster our Far Eastern possessions against foreign invasion.

journalEntries.goal: Establish and maintain a Subject relationship with all Afghan nations for 10 years
journalEntries.name: Secure Afghan Protectorate
journalEntries.reason: The mountainous borderlands between the Indian subcontinent and the steppes of Central Asia hold the key to establishing a solid and advantageous border against our rival. To secure protection of our interests and a route to assail our opponents, we must acquire stable Subjects throughout the Afghan region.

journalEntries.goal: Establish and maintain a Subject relationship with Persia for 10 years
journalEntries.name: Secure Influence over Persia
journalEntries.reason: Rich in wealth and resources, Persia also serves as a springboard for armies bound for the Indian and Central Asian heartlands. Any great power with stakes in these regions would be wise to secure this land for themselves, and wiser still to deny it to their adversaries.

journalEntries.name: Secure the Persian Border
journalEntries.reason: The presence of insurgent states in the North Caucasus threatens our control of the region, and by extension our ability to project power in the Middle East. The long-running Caucasian War must come to an end that is favorable to our nation.

journalEntries.name: Solidify Our Technological Advantage
journalEntries.reason: Numbers are great, but we shouldn't have to rely on having an overwhelming amount of soldiers if it can be helped. We should look into getting our soldiers the right tools for the right jobs.

journalEntries.name: Specialized Goods Production
journalEntries.reason: We should look to diversify our goods production further. We have started production of one good, but if we begin producing even more expensive goods, we will be able to export it to all the corners of the globe.

journalEntries.name: The Eastern Frontier
journalEntries.reason:
The great expanse to our east, dominated by once bustling cities such as … and …, have comprised part of … Khorasan ever since the days of Manochehr. While these lands have since been wrested from us by the passage of time and the domination of oppressive and powerful rulers, it can be so no longer.

Decisive steps must be taken to reintegrate these wayward lands, so that no foreign power may invade and subjugate them again.

Turanian Captivity
Generations of Turkmen raids into our lands have resulted in large populations of Persian slaves toiling in oases such as … and …. Capturing these areas will allow us to liberate and resettle enslaved Persian communties, if we so please.

journalEntries.name: The Great Game
journalEntries.reason:
Progress towards the left of the bar will benefit Great Britain, whilst progress towards the right of the bar will benefit Russia.

Beginning in the early nineteenth century, the Great Game has emerged as a generic term for conflicts between Great Britain and Russia for influence over … and its surroundings. With both governments regarding a comprehensive military victory against the other to be impossible, the Great Game has come to be waged through a series of indirect battles for leverage over countries on the line between both nations.

Victories:
………………
Advances:
Russia - Enforced the Treaty of Turkmenchay
Britain - Successful Expedition to Bukhara
……………

journalEntries.name: The Greatest Power
journalEntries.reason: We may be recognized on the global stage as a Great Power, but we should show the world that we are the Greatest Power, none should be our equal.

journalEntries.name: The Hegemon
journalEntries.reason: We have shown the world what we are capable of. We have made great strides. Now however we should make sure we have the population to back our global standing.

journalEntries.name: The Strong Market
journalEntries.reason: The time has come to establish ourselves as the largest and most powerful market on the globe.

journalEntries.name: Unify Afghanistan
journalEntries.reason: The fall of the Durrani Empire has left Afghanistan in a state of constant civil war between petty contenders for the throne. In order to ward off the enroaching European powers, we must form a unified and enduring Afghan state.

journalEntries.name: Utilizing Our Strength
journalEntries.reason: As we have decided to focus on using our industrial goods for ourselves. It would be best to keep the price of these goods as low as possible so as to not ramp up costs on other buildings that rely heavily on these goods to stay profitable.

journalEntries.name: Women and Children
journalEntries.reason:
We have taken many steps towards establishing our Egalitarian Society, but we still need to make sure that these rights are available to all. We should look towards ending unfair practices against women and children.

NOTE: Regressing any of the laws passed in the previous Journal Entries will result in this Journal being hidden and you will be unable to progress further through this objective until the law is enacted again.

journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Army Modernization
journalEntries.reason: Though the Janissaries have been disbanded, there is far more that must be done to modernize our armed forces.

journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Bureaucratic Reform
journalEntries.reason: Our bureaucracy is a patchwork of archaic laws and systems, with corrupt, autonomous Beys barely exerting control over the Empire's provinces. If we are to overcome the many challenges to our rule, we must modernize our administrative system.

journalEntries.goal: Increase the literacy rate of your people by 20%.
journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Education Reform
journalEntries.reason: So few within our domain have even a basic grasp of literacy. We should establish schools in which to teach them, as well as our own institute of higher learning.

journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Reclaim Egypt
journalEntries.reason: With Syria recaptured, we should turn our attention to Egypt. Rightfully an Ottoman possession, it has fallen into the hands of a usurper.

journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Reclaim Syria
journalEntries.reason: Syria has been lost to the tyrant of Egypt, who stole his dominion from our rightful hands. We must reclaim it!

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for 15 total years:
journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Suppress Separatism
journalEntries.reason: We have already lost Greece and Serbia; we cannot allow our empire to collapse to separatist rebels.

journalEntries.name: Tanzimat: Urbanization
journalEntries.reason: Our economy is underdeveloped and unurbanized. We must embark on the path of industrialization.

journalEntries.goal: Complete 4 'Tanzimat' Journal Entries
journalEntries.name: The Sick Man of Europe
journalEntries.reason: We must modernize and restore the Ottoman Empire.

"Death and famine on every side, and never a sign of rain
The bones of those who have starved and died, unburied upon the plain."

A great and terrible calamity has struck India. Owing to a series of poor harvests, and exacerbated by general poverty and governmental mismanagement, conditions have deteriorated to the point where a state of famine has officially been declared in ….

As long as the … persists, we can expect higher rates of agitation from forces hostile to our rule.

Famine in India
Highly dependent on favorable monsoon rains for irrigation, much of India is especially vulnerable to droughts and other adverse Harvest Conditions. To counteract this, the interior office has recommended we irrigate the interior drylands, to mitigate the impact of droughts.

journalEntries.goal: Increase the number of … in … by …
journalEntries.name: … Dictate: Agricultural Production
journalEntries.reason: The … in … routinely issues dictates regarding the direction of our operations in India. To comply with their current dictate, we must focus our efforts on constructing additional ….

journalEntries.name: … Dictate: Higher Education
journalEntries.reason: The … in … routinely issues dictates regarding the direction of our operations in India. To comply with their current dictate, we must focus our efforts on expanding the … system in each of our Presidency cities.

journalEntries.name: … Dictate: Law Enactment
journalEntries.reason: The … in … routinely issues dictates regarding the direction of our operations in India. To comply with their current dictate, we must focus our efforts on enacting ….

journalEntries.goal: Increase Army Power Projection by 25%, through either improving current units or constructing new ones
journalEntries.name: … Dictate: Military Expansion
journalEntries.reason: The … in … routinely issues dictates regarding the direction of our operations in India. To comply with their current dictate, we must focus our efforts on improving the size and quality of our armed forces.

journalEntries.name: Communal Divides
journalEntries.reason:
"Is it possible that two nations—the Mahomedans and the Hindoos—could sit on the same throne and remain equal in power?"

The history of Hindu-Muslim relations in India is both storied and complex, with episodes of collaboration and coexistence interwoven with ones of intolerance and cruelty. Nonetheless, for centuries, the two communities hobbled along under the auspices of their feudal masters.

However, with the emergence of new, national identities and the increasing spread of ethno-religious nationalism, it is clear that the old ways must make way for the new. Few voices, however, agree upon what such new ways should entail.

A nation in discord cannot hope to endure. In one way or another, unity must be achieved.

The Two-Nation Theory
Hinging on the belief neither Muslim nor Hindu can rule without oppressing the other, the so called two-nation theory has been gaining traction in recent years. As long as the Communal Divides Journal Entry is active, attraction to religious nationalist Political Movements will be increased.

journalEntries.goal:
Highest … Secession Progress less than 30% for 120 months
• (Currently this has been true for … months)
journalEntries.name: Consolidate Colonial Rule
journalEntries.reason:
The frontier of our Indian territories has proven a consistent source of risk. We are surrounded by disorderly polities under arbitrary rulers which may threaten the integrity of our territory at any time. In order to ensure the security of our core holdings, those native sovereigns who still evade our rule must be brought to heel, and any hint of popular resistance crushed before it spirals out of control.

As we expand our administration across India, we will have the opportunity to establish new Princely States to aid our administration. Assuming direct rule over too much land will cause the Liberty Desire of our existing subjects to increase.

journalEntries.name: Dravidian Movement
journalEntries.reason: The common people of … have responded to the disproportionate representation and political power of Brahmins. After a series of anti-Brahmin conferences, the Dravidian Movement has formed and set a new agenda to oppose Brahmin dominance. They seek to remove caste distinctions from law and government administration.

journalEntries.name: Imperialism of Promise
journalEntries.reason: We have a duty to promote the common good by any means necessary. Basic liberties and equal opportunities play a central role in policymaking. A … approach to colonial administration promises a strong force for progress both in the … and around the world.

journalEntries.name: Indian Home Rule
journalEntries.reason:
Across the …, national consciousness is rising amongst the native Indian population. Native Indians educated in … schools and employed by the colonial government have begun to agitate for equal status within imperial institutions, greater economic opportunity, and the eventual establishment of home rule for all of India.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, we will have the opportunity to petition … for greater autonomy and other local reforms. The chance that these petitions will be accepted is dependent upon the status of the progress bar.

journalEntries.name: Purveyor of Progress
journalEntries.reason: A grand railway network shall connect us all. It will bring great progress to the country and shape the future of our nation!

journalEntries.name: Sepoy Mutiny
journalEntries.reason: Mutiny and rebellion has broken out against the Company. If we are to maintain our authority, it must be crushed completely.

journalEntries.name: The … of India
journalEntries.reason:
…

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, Princely State Subjects with low Liberty Desire and high Relations will occasionally petition for accession into the ….

The Privy Purse:
The former rulers of the Princely States will be entitled to a state pension as compensation for accession to the …. The Privy Purse payments will add National Expenses of … times the number of Princely States annexed using this Journal Entry.…

journalEntries.name: The Indian Nation
journalEntries.reason: The collapse of goodwill between moderate nationalist leaders and the … colonial government has led to radicalization of the Indian national movement towards full independence. Those few who remain committed to the mission of the … fear that, barring extraordinary efforts, the … will soon be rendered ungovernable.

journalEntries.name: The Indian National Movement
journalEntries.reason:
Across the …, national consciousness is rising amongst the native Indian population. Native Indians educated in … schools and employed by the colonial government have begun to agitate for equal status within imperial institutions, greater economic opportunity, and self-governance for India.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, the … national movement will have the opportunity to petition us for greater autonomy and other local reforms. The repercussions for denying these petitions are dependent upon the status of the progress bar.

If the Activism of the Indian national movement gets too high, the movement will shift its focus towards full independence.

journalEntries.name: The Non-Cooperation Movement
journalEntries.reason: The national movement in … is gaining momentum, and its leaders have come up with a new campaign with a clear aim: economic and political non-cooperation, spurning collaboration with … authorities. They hope to demonstrate their movement's power by crippling the … trade of … with ….

journalEntries.name: Victoria Terminus
journalEntries.reason: Affiliates of the … have raised funds for the creation of a grand Terminus in Bombay. This elegant Terminus with additional railway platforms and adminstrative offices promises to elevate public opinion of India.

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for at least 40 years:
journalEntries.name: Brazilian Naval Power
journalEntries.reason: Ever since independence the Brazilian Navy has played a crucial role in safeguarding our sovereignty. We must strive to be the foremost naval power in South America, and among the greatest in the world.

journalEntries.name: Christ the Redeemer
journalEntries.reason: Affiliates of the …, seeking to demonstrate their faith and oppose perceived 'godlessness' in … society, have raised funds for the creation of a statue of Jesus Christ atop Mount Corcovado in ….

journalEntries.name: Coffee with Milk
journalEntries.reason:
The development of the … agricultural industry has concentrated a great degree of wealth into the hands of the agricultural "coffee and milk" barons. The recent coffee boom has created great opportunity for growth - but also great risk of concentrated political influence in the hands of agrarian ….

Effects at the conclusion of this Journal Entry will depend on the status of …'s Land Reform laws

journalEntries.name: Integrating the Brazilian Nation
journalEntries.reason: Brazil is a colony without a motherland; a state without a nation. To forge a single identity from all the peoples who inhabit this vast land will take careful deliberations, the completion of herculean tasks, and a steady hand. Is a single, united Brazil truly possible?

journalEntries.name: Populist Unrest
journalEntries.reason: The domination of … politics by the … has sparked discontent across the nation. Populist figures supported by the … agitate against the current government in the streets, and liberal military organizations look to the example of the Tenentes that stood against the agrarian oligarchy in the past. If this unrest is not successfully navigated, the ailing … faces a violent reorientation of power.

journalEntries.name: Ragamuffin War
journalEntries.reason: Rebels in Rio Grande do Sul are demanding independence, and are willing to pay for it with their blood.

journalEntries.name: The Matter of Slavery
journalEntries.reason:
The status of the Progress Bar will be determined by various #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_brazilian_slavery_tooltip_advance positive or #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_brazilian_slavery_tooltip_deplete negative conditions. The Progress Bar reaching 0 will lead to the ban on the slave trade being officially repealed, further entrenching the institution in Brazilian cultural and political life.

Decried as a cancer threatening the very foundations of … by its opponents, and lauded as a natural, necessary, and legitimate institution by its proponents, Slavery has defined the political landscape of … for centuries.

The South Atlantic Slave Trade
While Brazil officially committed itself to the ending of the … in the British-Brazilian Treaty of 1826, few steps have been taken since then to actually enforce the ban, and the trade remains effectively in place.

As long as Brazil maintains the … Law, … may feel justified in disrupting Brazilian vessels carrying slaves on the high seas.

journalEntries.name: The New …
journalEntries.reason: … … and … supporters have overthrown the previous government of …, and established a new regime founded on nationalism and modernization of the state.

journalEntries.goal: Increase the amount of Buy Orders for Coffee within the … by 150%
journalEntries.name: The River of Coffee
journalEntries.reason: … is blessed with a vast amount of fertile farmland, and a climate suited to the growing of highly profitable cash crops. This provides a great chance to enrich the nation and propel … products into worldwide prominence.

journalEntries.name: Great Reforms: Bureaucratic Reform
journalEntries.reason:
Despite the efforts of the previous Tsar to strengthen the state bureaucracy, the … state apparatus remains overly reliant upon arbitrary and antiquated local bodies. In order to see through our other reforms with the greatest efficacy, the equal rule of law and authority of the state must be ensured across our vast territories.

The taxation system, currently dependent upon local landowners collecting taxes from peasants, must be brought into the hands of the state. Likewise, local administrators must be made accountable, and the administrative privileges of the nobility reduced.

journalEntries.name: Great Reforms: Military Reform
journalEntries.reason: The Imperial Russian Army, largely made up of poorly-trained …, has fallen further and further behind the more professional military forces of Europe as time has passed. To make up for these defects, the quality of the Army's armaments and training must be improved, and conscription reformed to produce a larger pool of experienced military personnel.

journalEntries.name: Great Reforms: Peasant Reform
journalEntries.reason:
Discontent with the practice of … has long existed within reformist circles. Liberal … have criticized the practice for tying up vast sums of capital in owning unproductive serfs, limiting the ability of the aristocracy to invest in more productive spheres. So long as this practice continues, it will serve as a burden upon the potential of the state to undergo economic modernization.

In order to match the economic progress of Western Europe, the serfs must be emancipated, and the economy reoriented towards more productive ends.

journalEntries.goal: Complete 3 Great Reforms Journal Entries
journalEntries.name: The Great Reformer
journalEntries.reason:
The accession of … … to the … throne has been hailed by many reformers as a chance to completely remodel the antiquated structures of the … state. The reform-minded … has created a multitude of commissions to study and implement various reform proposals. If these "Great Reforms" can succeed, a reinvigorated … may surpass any other European power.

For the duration of … …'s reign, … characters will be much more likely to appear in ….

journalEntries.name: Honorable Restoration
journalEntries.reason:
The opening of Japan has unleashed forces beyond the control of the ruling Shogunate. Enraged by the encroachment of predatory foreign powers, militants of the … demand the deposition of the Shōgun, restoration of the power of the Emperor, and the expulsion of foreigners. All the while, ambitious … seek to use the weakness of the Shogunate to advance their own interests.

If Japan is to find a place in the world, she must realize the reform necessary to defend herself, and settle the conflict between her de jure and de facto sovereigns. Whether alone or alongside the Shōgun, the Emperor must rule.

As the Activism of the … increases, factions loyal to the Imperial Court will seek more forceful means to restore the Emperor.

journalEntries.name: Restoration: Achieve Recognition
journalEntries.reason: Japan has isolated itself for centuries to resist foreign influence. It is now time to open ourselves to the world, and establish our nation as an equal power on the world stage.

journalEntries.name: Restoration: Industrialize Japan
journalEntries.reason: Japan must modernize its industry to compete with nations that seek to control and exploit us.

journalEntries.name: Restoration: Retire the Samurai
journalEntries.reason: The Samurai are our ancient feudal-hereditary warrior caste. For centuries they have fought for us and commanded our armies. But in the centuries of relative peace we have enjoyed, they have forgotten the ways of war and have become a burden to the state.

journalEntries.goal: Complete all 3 Restoration Journal Entries
journalEntries.name: The … Restoration
journalEntries.reason:
The Emperor has been restored to power, and the process of building Japan anew can now begin. There is much work to be done. Foreign powers look at us with hungry eyes. We must be able to withstand the onslaught of these nations not just militarily, but in economic and political terms as well:

• …
• …
• …

We must build this new Japan while the iron is hot, and use this opportunity to shape the country in ways our forefathers never dreamed.

journalEntries.name: The Imperial Marriage
journalEntries.reason:
In … pursuit of unifying the Imperial Court and Shogunate, Shōgun … has secured a political marriage with Imperial Princess …. The Emperor's consent for the marriage is premised upon the expulsion of foreigners from the …, and a return to an isolationist policy.

If the Shōgun delivers upon … vows, the marriage will contribute greatly to healing the rift between Japan's de jure and de facto rulers.

journalEntries.name: The Algerian Departments
journalEntries.reason:
The transformation of Algeria from a colonial frontier ruled by the saber, to an integral part of metropolitan … has begun.

However, as our administrators discovered during the conquest, native loyalty is both hard-bought and fickle. In order to properly exploit the many resources of Algeria, we must either bring in a more loyal population base, or we must take drastic measures to ensure the loyalty of the one already there.

journalEntries.name: The Confederation of the Rhine
journalEntries.reason: From 1806 to 1813, by the design of Napoleon Bonaparte, the German states were unified under a single government - the Confederation of the Rhine. This edifice solidified Napoleon's control over Germany by proxy, containing the power of both Prussia and Austria. Reviving this arrangement will secure the power of … within Germany, and avert the design of an uncontrollable unified Germany.

journalEntries.name: The Conquest of Algeria
journalEntries.reason:
In 1827, the so-called Fan Affair resulted in a French military blockade of the Deylik of Algiers. Three years later, our troops landed on the shores of Algeria in force, decisively defeating the army of Hussein Dey at the battle of Staouéli. With his defeat, the old Deylik crumbled, but opportunists and pretenders rapidly filled the void it left behind.

Our conquest is not yet complete. Until the French banner flies from every Algerian hamlet and every rebel lies broken in the sand, we shall not rest.

Vive la France!

journalEntries.name: The French Foreign Legion
journalEntries.reason: If we are to rule in Africa, we must establish a permanent military presence on the continent. We must be prepared to accept that these forces will have to be recruited from local populations and from brave or desperate soldiers of foreign nations.

journalEntries.name: The Natural Borders of France
journalEntries.reason: Expansionistic tendencies have once again arisen in France. The citizens, or at least some of the loudest citizens, demand that our borders extend to the banks of the Rhine and the slopes of the Alps.

journalEntries.name: Christ of Nations
journalEntries.reason:
As Christ was martyred by the Romans, so too was Poland at the hands of her enemies, and as Christ is destined to come again in his glory, so too is Poland destined to do the same.

While the last independent … state disappeared off the map following the Three Partitions of the late 18th century, the dream of its revival lives on in the minds of Poles from Poznań to Lwów.

The Legacy of the Rzeczpospolita
Should a fully independent Polish state be established one way or another, we will be able to join their state to ours, provided … is itself independent.

journalEntries.name: Expanding the Commonwealth
journalEntries.reason: The borders of the old Commonwealth stretched far beyond the lands of the Poles and Lithuanians and into the vastness of Ruthenia. It shall do so again.

journalEntries.name: Destroy the Heavenly Kingdom
journalEntries.reason: Fanatics have risen up against our rightful rule! Their rebellion must be utterly crushed.

journalEntries.name: Fragile Unity
journalEntries.reason:
The status of the Progress Bar will #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_warlord_china_special_tooltip_advance advance or #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_warlord_china_special_tooltip_deplete retreat based on certain conditions. The Progress Bar reaching 0% will lead to the total loss of the central government's control, and the seizure of power by despotic local authorities.

Despite a period of temporary stability under the Yongzheng and Qianlong Emperors, China has embarked upon a steady slide towards collapse at the hands of rebellions, mismanagement, and external pressure. If the authority of the central government is sufficiently eroded, local military powers within … threaten to tear the country apart into petty fiefdoms.

journalEntries.name: The Boxer Rebellion
journalEntries.reason:
The humiliating loss of Chinese lands to foreign "barbarians" has resulted in the formation of numerous martial arts-inspired militias intent on purging the country of any foreign influence.

Failure to see the militias vision through could have dramatic consequences for ….

journalEntries.name: The Chinese Missions
journalEntries.reason: The opening of certain … cities to Westerners has permitted … missionaries to penetrate further into our country. Elements throughout … society have come to regard these missionaries as the vanguard of Western interference in the established order.

journalEntries.name: The Heavenly Kingdom
journalEntries.reason: Dangerous zealots are inspiring dissent across the nation. They pose an extreme threat; if they can rally enough people to their cult, they will attempt to establish their own heretic kingdom. These madmen must be stopped at all costs.

journalEntries.name: Magnanimous Monarch
journalEntries.reason:
The status of the Progress Bar will be determined by various #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_pedro_special_tooltip_advance positive or #tooltippable;tooltip:…,je_pedro_special_tooltip_deplete negative conditions. The Progress Bar reaching 0 will lead to the end of the liberal Emperor's reign, and the proclamation of a conservative Republic.

Emperor …, the second ruler of the Empire of …, has been thrust into his role at an early age following the abdication of his father. Pedro II aspires to maintaining democratic rule and protecting the civil liberties afforded by the constitution, as well as finally ending the institution of slavery which mars Brazil - despite the strength of the conservative forces arrayed against his liberal cause.

journalEntries.goal: … has been heir to the throne for at least 10 years
journalEntries.name: The Brazilian Succession
journalEntries.reason: Though … … is the legal heir to the throne, many within … will not accept a woman on the throne. The people will need time to see that the Princess will be a worthy successor to her father.

journalEntries.name: The Republican Proposal
journalEntries.reason: Progressive republicans have approached the Emperor with a plan to peacefully transition … towards becoming a …, with Pedro himself acting as the nation's first President.

journalEntries.name: Expulsion of Circassians
journalEntries.reason:
The government's ambition to settle the former territory of Circassia with loyal Cossacks has led to a ruthless campaign to evict the region's … population by any means necessary.

Whilst this Journal Entry is active, … Pops will be deported from our borders, at the cost of enormous loss of life.

journalEntries.name: Honor Before Life
journalEntries.reason: The imperial ambitions of … require the total destruction of our homes. To resist the … onslaught, we must unite the tribes of … to stand together in struggle.

journalEntries.name: Pacification of the Steppes
journalEntries.reason:
Despite nominal … control over the Kazakh steppe since the 18th century, banditry and disloyalty plagues the territory. Kazakh rebels, led by the aristocrat …, have begun striking again and again against our supply convoys and fortresses in the region.

Only with the final pacification of the steppe may the … truly be said to be the sovereign of Kazakhstan.

journalEntries.name: The Caucasian War
journalEntries.reason:
Our territorial ambitions in the Caucasus Mountains are being set back by fierce local resistance. We must crush all remaining resistance in order to secure our Southern border, and open the territories up for settlement.

Once the Rifling and Logistics technologies are researched, it will be possible to escalate the war, and launch a full-scale invasion of the rebellious states.

journalEntries.name: The Conquest of Turkestan
journalEntries.reason: To secure our Southern border, counter British power in India, and open routes through which we may extend … influence into the Middle East, the …'s government has issued the prerogative to establish protectorates across Central Asia, and expand our empire into Turkestan proper.

journalEntries.name: The Gazawat
journalEntries.reason: The imperial ambitions of … require the subjugation of the Caucasus. To combat the … Orthodox invasion, we must unite the peoples of the …, and stand together in holy struggle.

journalEntries.name: The Last Kazakh Khan
journalEntries.reason: Proclaimed by representatives of the three Zhuzes to be the Khan of a reunified …, … has openly risen against … rule. In order to secure the Kazakh territories once and for all, the rebel Khanate must be destroyed.

journalEntries.name: The Ruler of the East
journalEntries.reason: Our ambitions of becoming a Pacific naval power, and our colonial agenda in Central Asia, require that we resolve our long-standing border disputes with … in a manner favorable to ….

journalEntries.name: The Trans-Siberian Railway
journalEntries.reason: Siberia is rich in resources but poor in infrastructure. We must build a great railway that will traverse the vast distance between Moscow and the Pacific!

journalEntries.name: Equality for All
journalEntries.reason: This nation fought a war over deep issues that were papered over for generations until the problems became too big to ignore. We must avoid a repeat of this disaster, and tackle the problems head-on lest they are left to fester for another century.

journalEntries.name: Readmit the Secessionist States
journalEntries.reason: Readmitting the rebellious states back into the Union is essential for restoring the shaken spirit of the nation, and may help establish new powerbases for the government.

journalEntries.goal: Reconstruct the formerly-rebellious states.
journalEntries.name: Reconstruction
journalEntries.reason: With the Civil War behind us, now is the time for former secessionist states to be reintegrated into the Union.

journalEntries.name: The American Civil War
journalEntries.reason: War between the states is upon us. Now is the time to preserve the Union, or die trying.

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for 10 total years:
journalEntries.name: The Slavery Debate
journalEntries.reason: Slaveholders and abolitionists are engaged in increasingly rancorous debate across the nation. Sooner or later, the arguments will stop being made with words and start being made with bullets.

journalEntries.goal: The following must be true for 5 years total:
journalEntries.name: The Wild, Wild West
journalEntries.reason: The western frontier has been set alight by the unrest in the rest of the nation. We must find a way to calm it down.

journalEntries.name: The Lippe Crisis
journalEntries.reason: The presence of numerous feral Lippes is making investors nervous, we have to ensure all Lippes are properly cared for or else the global economy will collapse.

journalEntries.goal: Bolstered a Political Movement for … weeks
journalEntries.name: Bolster a Political Movement
journalEntries.reason: It is time to choose a political vision for your country. Review your active Political Movements and choose one or several to Bolster for the rocky road ahead.

journalEntries.name: Change Commander Order
journalEntries.reason: Our Military Units stand ready to fight the enemy. By default our commanders will be on aggressive orders. Those orders can be shifted to deal with other situations. We should change the orders of … to Defend Front so we are prepared for more situations.

journalEntries.goal: The new Production Method on … in … has been active for …/… weeks.
journalEntries.name: Change Production Method
journalEntries.reason:
… in … is a Building whose earnings could potentially be improved by changing a Production Method.

For the purpose of this lesson, it is recommended that you change a relatively safe Production Method, such as activating … or … production on a farm, or the use of … on a ranch.

journalEntries.name: Colonize State
journalEntries.reason: We should look to expand our empire abroad by Colonizing a Decentralized Nation.

journalEntries.name: Create Formation
journalEntries.reason: The Army is the backbone of our power. Creating new Armies is a must for not only maintaining the security of our borders, but also increasing our influence. Having more Armies to command will also increase the flexibility of our deployments allowing for Military Units to defend our more potentially dispersed territories.

journalEntries.goal: Obligations earned from other nations: … / …
journalEntries.name: Earn Obligation
journalEntries.reason: Obligations are an important aspect of global politics. They allow us to call on other nations to help us in times of war and allow us to force certain Diplomatic Actions on other nations.

journalEntries.goal: Establish and maintain an Interest in … for … weeks
journalEntries.name: Establish an Interest
journalEntries.reason:
To expand your influence beyond your borders, you should look to establish an Interest in the Strategic Region in which the capital of another nation is. 
Build up Involvement until you reach the … Tier in ….

journalEntries.name: Establish Company
journalEntries.reason: With extensive and Productive Buildings, we can look to increase their Throughput. Chartering a Company to help manage our industries will help to improve their effectiveness. These Companies will improve all their affected Buildings.

journalEntries.goal: Level … … in … (currently level …)
journalEntries.name: Expand a basic Building
journalEntries.reason: One way of growing your economy is by constructing or expanding Buildings. You cannot always know ahead of time if a certain Building will be profitable or not, but expanding a basic agricultural Building such as … is a relatively safe investment.

journalEntries.goal: Level … … in … (currently level …)
journalEntries.name: Expand a Productive Building
journalEntries.reason: The … in … is a highly productive Building that is bringing in a large amount of revenue compared to its expenses, making it an ideal candidate for expansion. Expand this Building in order to grow our Gross Domestic Product and tax base.

journalEntries.goal: Number of Battalions in your Army is at least …
journalEntries.name: Expand The Military
journalEntries.reason: To maintain peace, we must look to ensure our security. Our army could use some bolstering. Not only will this be useful should we find ourselves in a war, but also when projecting our power.

journalEntries.goal: Maintain a positive Capacity balance for …/… weeks
journalEntries.name: Fix Capacity Deficit
journalEntries.reason: Overusing your country's Capacities imposes serious penalties. Sort this problem out as soon as possible, either by increasing your generation or decreasing your usage.

journalEntries.goal: … has maintained a Productivity of at least 5.0, or been Subsidized, for …/… weeks.
journalEntries.name: Fix Unproductive Building
journalEntries.reason:
The … in … is not bringing in sufficient revenue compared to its expenses to stay competitive.

Use of what you have learned about Buildings and Production Methods to try and resolve this problem. You can also try to solve the problem with Subsidies.

journalEntries.name: Form Power Bloc
journalEntries.reason: As a Great Power we must show strength. Other Great Powers are Power Bloc Leaders. We should look to creating our own Sphere of Influence if we hope to compete with the others. Creating a Power Bloc will allow us to keep a closer grip on Countries that we may wish to keep influence over.

journalEntries.goal: Have a GDP of …
journalEntries.name: Grow GDP
journalEntries.reason:
This is an open-ended task that makes use of all that you have learned about Buildings, Markets and Trade to grow the Gross Domestic Product of your country.

Building Buildings, growing your Population, tweaking Production Methods and manipulating Market prices are all potential ways to grow your Gross Domestic Product.

journalEntries.name: Improve Access to Consumer Goods
journalEntries.reason: Many of your Pops in … are reporting that they are having a hard time getting access to …. Alleviating these pains for your Pops will increase Standard of Living and help build Loyalty.

journalEntries.name: Improve Supply Network
journalEntries.reason: Our Supply Network has begun to buckle under the strain of overuse. You should look to remedy this before it becomes a larger issue and begins affecting our Trade Treaties or overseas Market Access and army Supply.

journalEntries.goal: … has … Incorporated States (currently …)
journalEntries.name: Incorporate State
journalEntries.reason: There … currently … Unincorporated States that can be Incorporated in …. Incorporating a State will increase your Tax revenue and make it easier to manage.

journalEntries.goal: Increase Population by … (currently … / …)
journalEntries.name: Increase Immigration
journalEntries.reason: Development in … is putting a strain on the local labor supply. There is plenty of available labor elsewhere in the …. Encouraging Migration to … could help us with this matter.

journalEntries.name: Increase Infrastructure by Railways
journalEntries.reason: Infrastructure in … is no longer sufficient to support its industries, impacting Market Access. Invest in local Railways to fix this problem once and for all.

journalEntries.goal: … has had … Decree in place for … weeks
journalEntries.name: Increase Market Access by Decree
journalEntries.reason: Market Access in … has dropped below 100%, causing adverse price conditions. Improve this by issuing the … Decree in ….

journalEntries.name: Increase our Foreign Investment
journalEntries.reason: The nation of … currently allows for us to build in their Country. We should take advantage of this by expanding Buildings that can bolster both Countries’ economies.

journalEntries.goal: Increase relations with … to …
journalEntries.name: Increase Relations
journalEntries.reason: Your ability to make it through the tumultuous 19th Century will increase greatly if you get along with countries around you, and maybe make one or two strong allies. … with … to form a closer bond between your countries, increase the likelihood of them agreeing to future Diplomatic Pacts and supporting your side in Diplomatic Plays.

journalEntries.goal: Level … … (currently level …)
journalEntries.name: Invest into an Institution
journalEntries.reason: You can increase your investment into the … Institution to increase its impact on your population.

journalEntries.goal: Increase … Appeasement to … (currently level …)
journalEntries.name: Lobby Appeasement
journalEntries.reason: One of our Interest Groups has started a Political Lobby targeting …. Appeasing our Interest Groups will give them more Approval to use in the enacting of new Laws and potentially unlock more Interest Group Traits.

journalEntries.name: Make Interest Group Happy
journalEntries.reason: The … seem to have a low Approval of our Government. We should keep them happy to avoid any potential of them becoming Radicalized and turning against us.

journalEntries.name: Make Peace
journalEntries.reason: All wars eventually come to an end. We should look to make sure we get as much out of this conflict as possible. It is important to remember it is some times better to gain nothing then lose everything.

journalEntries.name: Mobilize A Formation
journalEntries.reason: Now that we are at War we should mobilize our forces. If we do not, our forces will be unable to defend our country effectively.

journalEntries.name: Passing an Institutional Law
journalEntries.reason: There is a surplus in our Bureaucracy. We should look to passing a law that will allow us to invest this surplus back into our Pops.

journalEntries.goal: Keep your Principal (…) below your Credit Limit (…) for …/… weeks
journalEntries.name: Recover From Default
journalEntries.reason: It appears that you have fallen into Default. While in default we will be unable to expand any of our buildings. The longer you stay in default the more likely it will start to have a negative effect on our economy.

journalEntries.name: Recruit and Promote a Commander
journalEntries.reason: Now that our army has Military Units we will need to put someone in charge of these Military Units. Without a commander the army will have low organization and not be as effective if we find ourselves in a conflict. We should be prepared for this eventuality.

journalEntries.name: Reform the Government
journalEntries.reason: Our Legitimacy is becoming rather low. If it continues to drop, it will become increasingly more difficult for us to pass new Laws. We can fix this problem with Reform to our Government.

journalEntries.name: Research a Technology
journalEntries.reason: We should select a Technology to research that best fits our needs for the future. It is best not to fall behind in this new age.

journalEntries.name: Send Formation To The Front
journalEntries.reason: … has been Mobilized but hasn't been sent to a Front. If the … isn't send to a Front, these forces will be divided up between multiple potential Fronts. This will hamper their ability to effectively influence the outcome of the war.

journalEntries.goal: Raise our national Prestige up to … (Currently: …)
journalEntries.name: Solidifying our Position
journalEntries.reason: In order to gain recognition on the international stage we should look to increasing our Country’s standing on the world stage. We can accomplish this by either raising our national Prestige or by elevating our nation to a higher Country Rank.

journalEntries.name: Solve Budget Deficit
journalEntries.reason: Our economy is currently unhealthy, as our fixed expenses exceed our revenues, resulting in a weekly deficit. There are several ways to address this, such as raising taxes, cutting government/military wages, or reducing the levels of government-funded buildings.

journalEntries.name: Start Diplomatic Play
journalEntries.reason: Now that we have established an Interest in a Strategic Region, we should look to start a Diplomatic Play to expand our borders.

journalEntries.name: Stop the Revolution
journalEntries.reason: We have a Revolution brewing in our country. We should take the appropriate steps needed to quell this before it breaks out into a Civil War.

journalEntries.name: Subject Liberty Desire
journalEntries.reason: Your Subject … is about to reach a dangerous level of Liberty Desire. When it reaches the final level they may attempt to increase their Autonomy or even try and become independent. We risk losing control of them if this progresses.

journalEntries.name: Target In Diplomatic Play
journalEntries.reason: We have been targeted by another nation in a Diplomatic Play. We need to act quickly and add a wargoal to this play and prepare to defend ourselves.
